articleTitle: Optimizing Cloud Data Centers for Environment Sustainability through Performance-Aware Virtual Machine Allocation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Cloud computing faces challenging issues concerning high-energy consumption and service-level agreement (SLA) violations, particularly as the demand for computational power continues to grow, necessitating large-scale cloud data centers. Existing energy-aware approaches tend to focus on performance optimization during VM migration phases but it can be effectively maintained at VM allocation level as preprocessing. Thereby, this paper proposed Energy Efficient SLA-aware virtual machine Allocation approach using a metaheuristic Firefly algorithm (FFO-EESA). The experimental findings showcase promising outcomes in the context of dynamic workloads and varying numbers of VMs (ranging from 1 to 290) allocated on individual hosts. The proposed method’s experimental results were obtained through computer-based simulations conducted in MATLAB version 2017(a). The outcomes showed that, there was a reduction of 12.34% in migrations and a saving of 4.36% in idle hosts with the FFO-EESA approach. proposed algorithm resulted in an average energy savings of 4.39% compared to the FF and MBFD techniques.

articleTitle: YOLOv8 based Traffic Signal Detection in Indian Road
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In the contemporary era of automation, the efficient utilization of technology is of paramount importance. However, despite these advancements, incidents such as road accidents persist as a critical concern. This study endeavors to streamline traffic signal detection as a proactive measure to mitigate road accidents and enhance road safety. The Smart Traffic Signal Detection System has been designed to identify traffic signals and proactively alert drivers, particularly in high-traffic situations. Additionally, the system assists in monitoring and recording traffic signal violators, providing valuable data for relevant authorities. This research introduces a novel system, utilizing the You Only Look Once (YOLO) algorithm within a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) framework, to enhance signal detection accuracy. Real-time data collected from various locations across the city of Kolkata forms the foundation for this system’s development.

articleTitle: Dual-band and dual-polarized antenna for GPS band and IOT applications
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper presents the design and analysis of a dual-band, dual-polarized antenna for applications in IoT and GPS band. This antenna operates at two distinct frequency bands, one at 1.5 GHz with narrowband linear polarization and another one at 2.8 GHz with wideband circular polarization and hence offering flexibility for various versatile communication requirements. A 3 dB axial ratio bandwidth of 200 MHz is obtained at the upper band frequency of 2.8 GHz, making it a viable candidate for IoT applications in various scenarios.

articleTitle: Analysis Inverter of PLTS On Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: As is known, the potential of Indonesia’s natural resources is quite high in solar energy if it is utilized to the best of its ability. By utilizing this energy, the use of electrical energy through PLN will be reduced or assisted in terms of electricity supply so that it can reduce the supply of existing loads. The effect of temperature from the photovoltaic system has an impact on the current and voltage output so that the resulting output will be optimal or not. Based on the data irradiation also affects the power output by the inverter. The inverter will also work properly when the standard value of the inverter specification will work when the minimum voltage value is in the range of 400V-800V and reads well above 800 V according to the experiment and the current is stated to be 12.5 A to 33 A with the data obtained above. So that the performance of the inverter is in its maximum condition, but when the irradiation condition decreases, the performance of the inverter will decrease, which can be seen from the power generated. The measured temperature based on the input data from the inverter shows a value above 25 °C will make the inverter work according to standard. When the work efficiency of the inverter decreases, the output power will not be optimal. but when the parameters of the PV system start from temperature to optimal irradiation level, the input and output of the inverter also work optimally.

articleTitle: Transistor Size Optimized Ultra-low Power NNPT and PNPT Level Converter Designs
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Ultra-low power applications viz. energy harvesting, biomedical signal processing, and wireless sensor nodes require sub-threshold or near-threshold circuits with level converter designs which are not only energy-efficient but also resilient to process variation. In this work, we have considered two single threshold 5 transistor (5T) level converters in 22 nm technology and modified the critical nmos and pmos transistors. Such modified architectures of level converters consume ultra-low power consumption and significantly less silicon area. Furthermore, we have carried out the worst case analysis to assess the robustness of those 5T LCs.

articleTitle: A Novel QR Code Based Smart Attendance Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This work proposes a novel attendance tracking system based on QR code. The implementation of a QR-based attendance system in educational institutions represents a technological advancement which ensures the accuracy of attendance tracking. The process begins with students registering with the institutional organization. Following registration, each student is assigned a unique QR code, which is subsequently printed on their institutional ID card. This QR code serves as a personalized identifier for attendance tracking purposes. The operational procedure involves students scanning their QR codes using installed cameras upon entering and leaving the college premises. The system captures this data and calculates attendance percentages automatically. The recorded information includes not only the attendance status but also the precise entry and exit timestamps. This comprehensive dataset is then stored in the student database, organized according to the academic calendar. The utilization of QR codes in this context simplifies the overall system operation, reducing the chances of errors in attendance tracking. The implementation of technology into the attendance recording process enhances efficiency and minimizes the load on administrative staff.

articleTitle: A Secure Text Steganography using Randomized Mathematical Functions and LSB
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In the realm of information security, hiding data within ordinary images, known as text steganography, has become a crucial method for secret communication. The Least Significant Bit (LSB) technique is a popular way to embed text within images. It works by tweaking the least significant bits of image pixels to represent hidden text in binary form. This alteration is subtle, ensuring the image looks normal and enabling efficient sharing through various platforms. This research paper introduces a creative expansion of LSB steganography. It utilizes LSB steganography for replacing the Least Significant Bits of the carrier image with the binary of the encoded text after the text has been passed through various mathematical functions like polynomials, integrals, and differentials. These functions are called randomly to encode text. Thus, enabling randomicity in the encoding of the text allows a secure and efficient way of encrypting and decrypting the text needed.

articleTitle: Design of a Compact Low Loss Four-Way Power Divider at W-band
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: We have developed a compact, wideband four-way power divider operating in the W-band, employing a Riblet-type coupler and compared its performance with the conventional four way power divider developed by concatenating two two-way E-plane power divider to the output of a two -way E-plane power divider or the turnstile power divider which has structural similarity to a turnstile, a rotating gate, and functions by distributing electromagnetic energy into separate waveguide paths. This Riblet power divider enables efficient coupling between four adjacent waveguides through narrow walls. To enhance the power divider’s performance, we’ve incorporated a taper in the input central waveguide, improving the return loss. Moreover, the power divider exhibits acceptable return loss and isolation between the output ports across the 81-86 GHz frequency range. Additionally, the amplitude imbalance between the output ports is minimal. The power divider boasts a fractional bandwidth of 5.98 %, and its coupling length is 1.7 times the guided wavelength $(\lambda g)$.

articleTitle: A low-profile circular microstrip antenna with recessed ground
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This work proposes a circular microstrip antenna with a low profile that uses recessed ground to shift the resonant band. The antenna design has a square-shaped substrate and ground plane, paired with a circular radiating patch. A square-shaped portion of the substrate has been cut out ensued the shifting of the resonant band. The designed antenna can be used for WiMAX (3.3-3.4 GHz) application band. The overall resonant bandwidth of the antenna for ($S_{11}\leq-10\mathrm{~dB}$) is 160 MHz 4.8% with a frequency range (3.27-3.43 GHz). The antenna’s gain is 5.35dB at 3.35 GHz and essentially stays constant throughout the resonant bandwidth. HFSS veri3 simulation software and theoretical calculations has been used to complete the antenna design.

articleTitle: Single-Phase Off-Grid PV System Battery Sizing Optimization using MATLAB Simulink
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The photovoltaic (PV) system is a clean and renewable energy that convert sunlight into electricity. The demand of PV systems in Malaysia is less significant with only 20% of electricity generated by renewable energy. Typically, high start-up results are obtained from the establishment of a PV framework. The rural zones in the country are unable to reach the power grid and therefore, the proposed strategy will certainly suggest a potential fixation for the issue. This paper presented the optimization of the size of PV arrays and battery for a single-phase standalone PV system (SAPV). The construction of the system starts with the calculation of a single-phase household load demand with high solar irradiance sources and exposed seaside location which can extract more sunlight in an open area. This work implements the use of Homer Pro software and MATL.AB (Simulink). Irradiance data is obtained from SOLCAST website and instigated in the design of the proposed SAPV framework Homer Pro software supports in optimizing the size of the battery storage and the PV module needed using load demand value specified in this work. MATLAB (Simulink) is used to design and simulate the proposed SAPV. This study showed a single-phase S.APV system with battery is successfully designed and simulated using both software tools. The outcomes can be used to confirm feasibility of the proposed methods towards the implementation of PV in rural areas.

articleTitle: Development of Integrated Structure of Hydrogen Production Using Photovoltaic Panels and Detailed Electrical Model for Electrolyser
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Sunlight power is a type of green energy that can be harvested by using photovoltaic (PV) panels to convert solar radiation to electrical power for fulfilling the power demand. However, there are limitations on renewable energy as it relies on weather conditions in which a confined portion of power will be generated during the night or cloudy periods. This is where hydrogen comes in and act as an energy career that stores the electrical power generated from the photovoltaic panel and can be converted back to electric power through electrochemical processes. The aim of this article is to analyse the feasibility of implementing PV panels and electrolyser for hydrogen generation. Simulation of solar system for power generation and detailed electrolyser with PEM cell stack is modelled for hydrogen production. Performance evaluation is then fulfilled to the developed simulation model of hydrogen production system for identifying the efficiencies of the developed PV system and PEM electrolyser as well as the solar to hydrogen’s turnover of the developed hydrogen production system to find out the feasibility of system.

articleTitle: Image Compression and Decompression based on FFT algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Image compression is a type of data compression technique, used to shrink costs for digital images storage or transmission. Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is an algorithm, which is broadly used for image compression. It calculates a sequence’s discrete Fourier transform (DFT) or inverse (IDFT). A signal’s representation in the temporal or spatial domain can be changed to the frequency domain by Fourier analysis, and vice versa. First, by removing high frequency components, one may achieve frequency domain picture compression. The compressed picture can then be recovered by applying the inverse FFT. The literature on rapid Fourier transform image compression is reviewed in this work. The fundamentals of Fourier and rapid Fourier transforms, as well as picture compression, are covered in this article. It also goes over a number of FFT-based image compression methods, such as JPEG, JPEG2000, and SPIHT. The benefits and drawbacks of utilizing FFT for picture compression are covered in the paper’s conclusion.

articleTitle: Sustainable Illumination: Leeds City Centre’s Transition to Solar Lamp Posts
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: As the world shifts towards renewable energy to decrease carbon emissions, photovoltaic panels are emerging as a transformative tool, finding application even in lampposts. The function of photovoltaic is to convert solar energy into electricity. In this project, a specific technology of solar cell, called monocrystalline, is being used due to its energy efficiency within a small surface area as well as its long-life span. A lead-acid battery is included in this project to store the solar energy during the daytime. Light-emitting diode (LED) lamp type is used in this project due to its efficiency and various features of lightning. The structure of the lamppost is made of steel and designed to be robust to minor traffic conditions. The street-lighting system is designed to turn off automatically during the day and turn on during night hours with a minimal upward escape of light into the night sky. The whole project is intended to be used in Leeds City Centre in the United Kingdom.

articleTitle: A New Differential Calibration Method for Measurement Accuracy Improvement of Atmospheric Radiation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: A new differential calibration method approach has been proposed for atmospheric radiometer for achieving better stability and sensitivity in this paper. Conventional total power radiometer has been modified to enhance the sensitivity, whereas inherent architecture of the system assures better stability than Dicke radiometer. First, the approach has been evaluated at V-band frequency for temperature profiling followed by at K-band frequency for humidity profiling. Design and simulation of the proposed method have been presented here. The proposed calibration method involves alternately switching two separate noise sources with different Excess Noise Ratio (ENR) values with precision timing. Simulation has been carried out to validate the calibration method. Measurement accuracy of atmospheric radiation during gain variation of the system has been minimized.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Accurate and Automated Brain Tumor Detection using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: A Deep Learning-based system for Brain Tumor detection was developed using advanced machine learning techniques. In this study, a brain scan dataset was used to train a convolutional neural network (CNN). A more accurate and specialized model was obtained using the proposed approach. The model was developed using Python and some popular deep learning frameworks like Tensorflow and Keras. Data preprocessing and feature selection were performed using Scikit-learn. Overall, the potential for improving patient outcomes by enabling earlier detection and more accurate diagnosis of brain tumors is presented by brain tumor detection models. Additionally, limitations in access to medical facilities and radiologists, particularly in resource-limited settings, can also be overcomed by these models.

articleTitle: Recommendation Systems in Education
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In the dynamic landscape of online education, the quest for effective course discovery is a multifaceted challenge. This paper investigates a recommendation system tailored to enrich course discovery on Udemy, employing a context-based, collaborative, and hybrid approach. Our system excels with a multi-dimensional course recommendation strategy, seamlessly blending three core techniques: context-based recommendations that consider user profiles and learning contexts, collaborative filtering to identify behavioral patterns and hybridization for fine-tuned suggestions aligned with immediate learning needs and user community insights. The paper delves into evaluating recommendation systems using appropriate metrics and benchmark datasets, addressing challenges like limited data and initiation hurdles with practical solutions. Looking forward, we explore the potential of emerging technologies, including deep learning and reinforcement learning, to further enhance recommendation algorithms. Our vision prioritizes personalization, diversity, and transparency, shaping the future of course recommendations on Udemy.

articleTitle: Electrical Characteristic analysis of Gate Underlap Strain Channel Cylindrical GAA FET
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this study, a gate underlap strained channel Cylindrical Gate All Around FET with an 8nm gate length was proposed and analyzed to provide faster switching with a lower subthreshold swing. It was accomplished by raising on-current by the use of a Type-II hetero-band structure, which improves increased carrier density and strained engineering on the channel, improving carrier flow via quasi-ballistic movement, and carrier density. The proposed device is made up of a cylinder-shaped outer s-Si layer that surrounds and creates a quantum well with the center s-SiGe layer and gate underlap area. This boosts the switching speed of the device while decreasing leakage current and attaining a reduced subthreshold swing.

articleTitle: Review and Selection of Proper Types of Waste Plastics for Producing Pyrolyzed Oil of High Calorific Value
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: As plastic has wide range of applications, its production is being grown day by day which creates the major problem in disposal of waste plastic products. Pyrolysis of plastic wastes can be a good solution of this disposal problem with the production of liquid fuel. It can also stop depletion of storage of the fossil fuel. Pyrolysis of waste plastics is a thermal and catalytic degradation process. As plastics are produced from crude oil, pyrolyzed oil produced is having high calorific value too. Therefore, it may be used as good alternative of nonrenewable fuel. But all the plastic products are not suitable for the pyrolysis process. Therefore, proper selection of waste plastic products based on their types and characteristics plays a very significant rule. In this present work a comparative study of characteristics of different types of waste plastic is carried out in details which will help to select proper waste plastic products for pyrolysis process so that liquid oil yield of best quality and high calorific value can be produced.

articleTitle: Correlating Clinical Properties of Angioitico-2 Electro-Homeopathy Remedy by Studying its Material Property
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Electro-Homeopathy is a Spagyric based herbal medical science, containing sixty exclusive remedies. The remedies are divided into nine groups containing specified group members. Angioitico-2 (A2) is the member of Angioitico Group. This remedy is made by the synergic combination of the spagyric essences of six specified plants, extracted by alchemical scientific processes. Each plant contains the active principle of their own. The resultant clinical properties of A2 effective on any disease of vein. On an application the resultant synergic properties cover and control the affected organ and group of organs. The clinical properties of A2 depends upon the resultant medicinal properties related to properties of the material effectively. Here, the material properties have been successfully explored and correlated by FTIR and ED XRF respectively.

articleTitle: Analyzing Customer Sentiment in Drug Reviews Using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The continuous expansion of the internet has led to a surge in user-generated content. Patients frequently share feedback about medications they have taken to express their experiences and raise public awareness. The application of sentiment analysis plays a crucial role in the healthcare sector, as it allows for examining these public reviews to assess the efficacy and popularity of various medications. This research presents a comprehensive sentiment analysis of customer reviews from DrugRev, a dataset of drug reviews. The study evaluates customer sentiment regarding drug effectiveness, side effects, and ease of use. We employ natural language processing using multiple machine learning and deep learning algorithms to obtain valuable insights into customer satisfaction and preferences, aiding consumers and healthcare professionals in making informed medication choices. The findings demonstrate that Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit and BERT outperformed all other models with an F1 Score of 92.17. The outcomes of our experiments illustrate that our system can deliver precise, effective, and scalable drug suggestions. By understanding customer sentiments, we contribute to improving healthcare decision-making and enhancing the quality of healthcare services.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Thin Film Transistor Configurations Using TCAD
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper gives a comparative study of thin-film transistor (TFT) configurations using TCAD by analyzing the structural and electrical properties of Staggered and coplanar TFTs by implementing these configuration structures in TCAD,and have studied the characteristics of top-gated and bottom-gated TFTs, both in Staggered and Co-Planar and compared the potential, electric field behaviour, and electron concentration.Our study aims to support the wide use in different electronic applications.Our comparisons in I-V characteristic of staggered bottom-gate, staggered top-gate, and coplanar top gate TFTs is that staggered bottom-gate TFTs offer the best performance in terms of on-current and field-effect mobility.

articleTitle: ECR plasma-assisted single-step synthesis of hydrogenated graphene
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: A novel approach for synthesizing hydrogenated graphene (graphane) using an in-house developed electron cyclotron resonance (ECR) plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PE-CVD) setup is reported in this article. A special type 2.45 GHz permanent magnet type ECR PE-CVD system has been created for the development of hydrogenated graphene at much lower operating temperature of 773 K in comparison to conventional thermal CVD. ECR plasma provides a significant portion of the heat. Moreover, the catalytic substrate is polycrystalline copper foil, which is first etched in resonant hydrogen plasma and annealed in presence of argon before being exposed to the gaseous plasma of the precursor inside the ECR PE-CVD reactor. Methane is employed as carbon precursor in order to maintain the ideal thermodynamic conditions for the production of hydrogenated graphene. The synthesis process in one-step is performed upon controlling the growth temperature, total pressure and synthesis time. The hydrogen exposure during ‘graphane’ development has been estimated using the in-situ quadrature residual gas analyzer (QRGA). Raman spectroscopy is performed to analyze the exposed copper foil in order to assess the quality of the synthesized material.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Effect of Spinodal Decomposition in Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The deposition of thin films has found many applications in Academia and Industry. The technology is capable of producing extremely thin films unattainable by the usual mechanical coating methods. The temperature regime where precipitation from vapour to solid begins is an important factor since it decides the type of ambient cooling or heating required. In this work, a model is applied to describe deposition, and the thermal regions where solutions are possible are analyzed by simulation including the 4th order derivatives for spinodal decomposition. The effect of spinodal transformation is analyzed. Applications are made to some commercially viable compounds.

articleTitle: Advancements in Fall Detection Technologies: A Comprehensive Review and Innovative Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The aging population is facing an increasing risk of accidental falls, making fall detection technologies crucial for public health and the well-being of elderly individuals. This paper provides a comprehensive research of sensor-based fall detection and rescue systems, categorizing them into single sensor-based and multiple sensor-based solutions. It explores the integration of Machine Learning (ML) and the Internet of Things (IoT) to address the challenges of real-time monitoring, high accuracy, and minimizing false alarms in fall detection. In the quest to enhance fall detection accuracy, innovative solutions are proposed, including the use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for efficient event classification. CNNs, originally designed for image analysis, exhibit impressive performance in processing time-series data from various sensors, such as accelerometers, gyroscopes, and ambient environmental sensors.These sensors, part of an IoT network, collect real-time data and transmit it to the CNN model, enabling rapid detection and response to fall incidents. The integration of contextual data from video and audio sources further aids in distinguishing real falls from other events generating similar vibrations. This innovation demonstrates remarkable mean sensitivities and specificities, addressing issues of computational demands and resilience. An accompanying mobile app complements the wearable system, enabling automatic fall detection and immediate alarms, which is vital for timely medical intervention. Continuous calibration and online learning mechanisms are also emphasized to ensure adaptability to changing environmental conditions and performance improvement over time. This comprehensive review and innovative solutions pave the way for more advanced, proactive, and accurate fall detection systems, offering a practical and promising approach to mitigate the consequences of accidental falls among the elderly.

articleTitle: Detection of Breast Cancer using a Flexible Antenna at ISM Band
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Breast cancer is a major health issue affecting women globally, and for detection traditional medical imaging methods like ultrasound and X-ray mammography have drawbacks due to low tissue contrast and potential risks. A low-cost wearable wireless antenna designed at 5.8 GHz is designed which can be integrated in wearable garments and in flexible biomedical devices. The antenna is constructed of a rectangular patch printed on a flexible Kapton polyimide substrate (relative permittivity, $\varepsilon r=3.4$) The prototype has been tested in concave bent geometries for radii of 25,45, and 73m.After bending there is a slight shift in the S-Parameter from 5.8GHz to 5.734 GHz, 5.7535GHz and 5.752GHz. When a breast phantom with tumor is positioned at a certain distance from antenna, a slight shift of S-parameter is observed. Compared to non-malignant breast cells, malignant cells have distinct electrical properties. SAR value of the proposed antenna is 0.496 W/kg for 10 g and 1.27 W/kg for 1 g of body tissue which is safe for body tissue. The designed antenna’s compact, portable, and flexible design, along with its performance in bending forms, demonstrate its applicability forfuture electronic devices.

articleTitle: Exploring Arduino based Electronic Circuit Design: A Study of Innovative Applications and Prototypes
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper delves into the escalating importance of Arduino in electronic circuit design, highlighting its user-friendly ecosystem. Its versatility makes it an optimal selection for professionals, students and hobbyists with impressive features like flexibility while being cost-effective coupled with seamless compatibility across a range of sensor modules. The adaptability enabled by these attributes ensures that Arduino can be used effectively across diverse settings and industries beyond electronics circuits alone. The paper underscores the practical application of Arduino through two prominent examples. One such instance is demonstrated by a rain-sensing wiper system, where its efficiency is showcased for home automation purposes. Another example illustrates an implementation of the heartbeat pulse sensor to emphasize how useful Arduino can be in healthcare applications. These applications indicate that apart from being adaptable, this technology possesses immense potential for innovation across diverse domains too strips. The paper discusses how Arduino has emerged as a pivotal tool in electronic circuit design, providing an accessible interface that promotes innovation and resolution of issues across various domains such as professional pursuits, learning environments, and leisure activities.

articleTitle: Minimizing the weight uncertainty in Neural Networks Using Bayesian Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Here is a draft abstract comparing convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) for modeling uncertainty in neural networks: Neural networks have become a popular and powerful tool for many machine learning tasks. However, standard neural networks tend to produce overconfident predictions and do not properly model uncertainty. This is concerning in applications such as medical diagnosis or autonomous driving where assessing model confidence is crucial. Two approaches to address this limitation are Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) and ensemble methods such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs). BNNs place prior probability distributions over model weights and use Bayes’ rule for inference. This allows BNNs to represent both epistemic uncertainty and aleatoric noise. Meanwhile, CNN ensembles train multiple models on different subsets of the data and aggregate their predictions. This captures more realistic variance across the ensemble. In this work, we evaluate and compare these two approaches for modeling uncertainty on image classification tasks. Our experiments show that BNNs can better capture epistemic uncertainty due to limited data; Predictions are aggregated across the ensemble, capturing variance due to data subsampling. While CNN ensembles do not explicitly model epistemic uncertainty, the variance between models increases with greater model capacity and smaller datasets, partially capturing this effect. Ensembles are computationally expensive, requiring training multiple models.

Author Keywords: Convolutional neural network Uncertainty in weights

articleTitle: Study of Field Distribution and Energy Density in an Indigenous DC Magnetron Sputtering Setup
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Magnetron sputtering is a widely used physical deposition technique for developing both metallic and nonmetallic thin films. Researchers discovered interest in this method because of its uniform deposition, high deposition rate and low cost. This study uses the Electrostatic and Magneto-static solver program in CST Studio software to simulate the field distribution and energy distribution of a DC magnetron sputter-head that was designed and manufactured domestically. Analysis has been carried out on the field variation plot and energy density variation plot against the diameter for 3 different negative voltages: -300 V, -500 V and -800 V that were acquired from the simulation study.

articleTitle: Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Work
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In today’s world the emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) will result in a transformation of characteristics of employment. Due to the Advancement in this sector which has enabled new forms of automation and increased efficiency, it will result in creating concerns about job displacement, inequality, and the potential loss of human jobs to machines. The study related to the effects of artificial intelligence (AI) on employment. It will result in highlighting the best possible advantages and obstacles linked to this advanced technology like artificial intelligence. This paper reviews the current research on the topic and shows findings from a survey of workers in other industries. According to the survey, we are successfully able to find employees who acknowledge the possible advantages of AI. However, they also express concerns regarding its effects on employment stability and its capability to worsen prevalent discrepancies. This paper concludes by promoting policy recommendations for addressing the problems associated with AI and ensuring that this technology is Adapted.

articleTitle: Fractional Order PID Controlled PV Fed Buck Boost Converter with Coupled Inductor for Battery Charging Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: solar energy is one of the promising alternate energy sources for easing the strain of fossil fuels. The load control is made better by the PV supplied Buck Boost converter with linked inductor. The many closed loop regulated techniques for battery charging systems are examined in this investigation. The objective of this effort is to enhance the battery charging system’s dynamic responsiveness for the use in electric vehicle applications. Modelling, simulation, and analysis of the resulting data are done for PV fed closed loop controlled battery charging systems. Using a FOPID controller, the suggested system’s performance has improved by means of peak over shoot, settling time, steady state error, and ripple in current.

Author Keywords: Fractional Ordered Proportional Integral and Derivative (FOPID) controller
Buck Boost Converter with Coupled Inductor (BBCCI)

articleTitle: Low-Cost Relative Humidity Measurement Based on Wet Bulb Thermometers
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The wet bulb temperature, representing the lowest temperature achievable through evaporative cooling, is a crucial measurement for assessing moisture levels in the air. It is influenced by air temperature, humidity, air pressure, wind speed, altitude, and solar radiation. By accurately measuring the wet bulb temperature, we can gain insights into the humidity level and potential health risks associated with different environmental conditions. This paper presents a wet bulb thermometer setup that enables the measurement and display of relative humidity and temperature. Employing Arduino technology and sensors offers a practical and accessible solution for monitoring environmental conditions. The accuracy and limitations of the method are discussed, emphasizing its usefulness in diverse fields and highlighting the importance of understanding relative humidity and temperature for various applications.

articleTitle: Enhancing Potato Disease Classification with Inception V3-Based Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Potato cultivation is a cornerstone of global foods production, however it is always threatened with the aid of the usage of a range of illnesses that can notably limit crop yield and quality. Traditional methods of disease detection are normally time-consuming and error-prone, prompting the adoption of deep gaining information of strategies for automated illness classification. In this research, we suggest a sturdy and right reply for potato disease classification, leveraging the electrical energy of InceptionV3, a present day convolutional neural neighborhood (CNN) architecture. Our model is trained to classify potato vegetation into three classes: Early Blight, Late Blight, and Healthy, specifically based totally on leaf conditions. Extensive experimentation on a dataset of potato leaf portraits demonstrates the efficacy of our approach, with a classification accuracy of 96.38%. Our discover out about contributes to the growing physique of search for in the challenge of plant disease detection, presenting an computerized and surroundings pleasant reply to embellish crop administration practices. This search for has the attainable to revolutionize disorder prognosis in agriculture, making positive properly timed intervention and sustainable ingredients production.

articleTitle: DFT based Molecular Structure Analysis of DNA Nucleotides: Quantum Chemistry based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This research analyzes each components of a DNA strand which are adenine (A), guanine (G), cytosine (C), and thymine (T) as an individual molecule and portrays results based on the experiments using density functional theory (DFT) study employed on Gaussian 16 and GaussView 6.0 platform. This paper aims at the understanding of each molecule based on study of the molecular orbitals and molecular electrostatic potential (MEP). Electron donating and accepting capacity, molecular stability and reactivity of the molecules were interpreted from the investigation of the HOMO and LUMO parameters, whereas the sites of donation and acceptance of electrons, physiochemical properties, distribution of charge of the molecule and intermolecular interactions were studied from the analysis of the MEP plots. These results accelerate the knowledge and detailed understanding of these molecules to a great extent in the field of medical science.

articleTitle: Tropospheric Scintillation in the Indian Tropical Hilly Region
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Mountain areas experience random turbulent irregularities of temperature, humidity, and pressure causing degradation in the satellite-received signal both in amplitude and phase at frequencies higher than 10 GHz. It brings a poor signal quality for daily usage of satellite communication in the region. A study and analysis of this type of scintillation have been done here which is significant for Ku and Ka bands for regular communication. A prediction model of scintillation for the tropical hilly region has been developed and validated. Frequency scaling on the model has also been done.

articleTitle: Novel Ultrawide band Multi Input/Multi Output Antenna Design with Single Notch Characteristics and Investigation with Improved Isolation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The research work proposes a MIMO i.e. multi input multi output antenna in circular shape with sufficient isolation for ultrawide band applications with single notch characteristics. To reduce mutual coupling among MIMO elements, a decoupling stub is utilized, which can reach up to - 50 dB over the bandwidth. The suggested antenna is suitable for usage in both UWB applications. The suggested antenna is 28*26*1.57 mm3 in overall dimension. In the range of 3–12 GHz, the S11 i.e. the return loss parameter and VSWR are less than -10 dB and 2, subsequently for the considered ultrawide band MIMO antenna. The recommended ultrawide band antenna design has an impedance bandwidth of about 9 GHz. The recommended antenna is designed and simulated in HFSS.

articleTitle: Alchemical Cohobation Method to Prepare Electro-Homeopathic Remedies
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: ‘Cohobation’ is an alchemical scientific process, consists of three steps, Extraction of Sulphur, Mercury and Salt. In Cohobation complex synergic essences are made from 114 plants by extracting the energy from the living plants and eliminating harmful properties. This method for preparing medicines from medicinal plants was invented in 1865 by Italian herbalist Dr. C. C. Mattei.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of LoRA Finetuning Llama-2
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative force, particularly in the realm of Large Language Models (LLMs), which have long been in existence but recently gained substantial impact in our daily lives. Our research endeavors focused on the exploration and open-sourcing of Llama-2, a significant LLM, through fine-tuning with the Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) technique. The satisfactory results obtained from the LoRA fine-tuning of Llama-2 have laid a foundation for further research in this domain. Positioned as the premier open-sourced model, rivaling even GPT-4, Llama-2 holds great promise for diverse research applications. Its status as a transformer model, coupled with refined hyperparameter tuning, positions Llama-2 as a pivotal tool for research and practical applications in the foreseeable future. Leveraging a text summarization dataset, our study demonstrated the enhanced performance of finetuned Llama-2, suggesting its potential for broader applications and furthering its significance in cutting-edge research. The dataset was imported from the hugging face space on which we tried to finetune the model. Thus, the fine-tuned Llama-2 is truly a force to be reckoned with.

articleTitle: Modelling of Wind Turbine and Study its Operation at Various Input Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this paper a wind turbine has been modelled and its working mechanism has been explained. For that a mathematical expressions of the output power of a typical wind turbine is taken. To calculate the output power and torque a simulink model is developed based on the mathematical equation of power of wind turbine. The variation of power and torque for a change in the input parameters like blade radius, wind speed, pitch angle are observed.

articleTitle: Steric Hindrance Issue in Junctionless FinFET based Biosensor under Diversified Temperature Variation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this research work, an extensive appraisal of the Junctionless FinFET Biosensor has been reported considering a prominent Steric Hindrance Issue in the biosensor. Keratin Biomolecule has been taken to study label-free detection. Different profiles of occupancy of Keratin Biomolecule have been considered to investigate the Steric Hindrance Issue. The dynamics produced under a diversified temperature range from 250K to 350K have also been studied. The results are recorded in terms of the changes in various sensing parameters, namely, Threshold voltage, Drain current, Transconductance and Sensitivity based on both the OFF current as well as on ratio of ON to OFF current.

articleTitle: Detection and Analysis of Skin Cancer using different Machine Learning for enhanced accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The main aim of this research work is to analyze the performance of skin cancer with respect to the finding of accuracy level. In this analytic research, 2230 images were employed from Kaggle datasets and ISIC database. The images comprised 350 nevus, 420 melanoma, 150 vascular lesion, 120 actinic keratoses (AK), 190 Squamous cell carcinoma, 380 basal cell carcinoma (BCC), 80 seborrheic keratosis, 450 pigmented benign keratosis, and 90 dermatofibroma. In this research, many machine learning algorithms and deep neural algorithm are considered. Different machine learning algorithms are convolutional neural network (CNN), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Support vector machines (SVMs), K-Nearest Neighbors Algorithm (KNN), Residual neural network (ResNet), Long Short Term Memory (LSTM), and Artificial neural network (ANN). In which CNN performs better in comparison with all other algorithm models. The average accuracy obtained for CNN in terms of classification skin cancer image is 91.71 %, 93.74 % for specificity.

articleTitle: MLing-Net: A computationally inexpensive deep neural framework designed to perform multilingual image document classification
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Multilingual image document classification has become an emerging research topic in the present era because of immense social, economic, and cultural perspectives. It supports economic globalization by aiding multinational companies in streamlining operations, including documentation and marketing, across regions with distinct languages. It enhances market reach by catering to a global audience with diverse linguistic preferences. Despite real-world significance of this research area, it remains less explored, leaving numerous aspects yet to be investigated. To mitigate this drawback, in this work we have designed a computationally inexpensive light-weight deep neural network framework namely, MLing-Net to perform multilingual image document classification. Apart from designing this novel deep learning framework, another significant contribution of this work lies in the integration of five new activation functions as replacement of existing popular activation functions in the designed network. These new activation functions are designed by leveraging the advantages of existing activation functions. The effectiveness of the proposed activation functions as well as novel MLing-Net is validated using popular multilingual historic image document databases and the excellence of the newly designed activation functions and network over their existing counterparts is established using quantitative parameters like Test Accuracy, Precision, Recall,F1 score and Total parameter count.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Ovarian Cancer Prediction Using Machine Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The growth of cells in the ovaries is the cause of ovarian cancer. Healthy body tissue can be destroyed quickly by the cells, which can rapidly multiply. There are two ovaries in the female reproductive system, one on each side of the uterus. Eggs and the hormones estrogen and progesterone are produced by each of the almond-shaped ovaries. This work aims to perform predictive analytics for early diagnosis by combining statistical techniques and machine learning models with clinical data from 349 patients. The significant blood biomarkers are determined by applying the student’s t-test and the log fold changes of two groups in statistical analysis. In addition, a collection of machine learning models, such as Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree (DT), Extreme Gradient Boosting Machine (XGBoost), Logistic Regression (LR), Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), and Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LGBM), are used in the creation of classification models to differentiate between patients with malignant ovarian cancer and those with benign ovarian cancer. Serum samples of human epididymis protein 4, carbohydrate antigen 125, carbohydrate antigen 19-9, and carcinoembryonic antigen were found to be the most useful biomarkers using both methods. Additional general chemistry tests included neutrophil ratio, thrombocytosis, hematocrit, calcium, indirect bilirubin, uric acid, and atriums. Additionally, the predictive analysis results demonstrate that, up to 98 percent of the time, the machine learning models can correctly distinguish between patients with benign and malignant conditions. Machine learning detection has the potential to significantly aid in the diagnosis of cancer because early-stage detection is typically unavailable.

articleTitle: Exploring the Role of Automated Video Inspection and Recognition in Security Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Security becomes the highest priority for people, organisations, and governments in a world that is getting more interconnected and complicated. The use of automated video inspection and recognition systems is becoming a very popular and effective method for strengthening security measures. This is a technology-driven system that integrates image processing, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning to identify specific objects, analyse their behaviour and movement and also recognize a specific trend to detect unusual activities. This comprehensive review paper explores and compares different technologies that have been used in automated video inspection and recognition systems. This survey paper aims to comprehensively examine several approaches used for automated video inspection. It explores the real-world applications and challenges of automated video inspection systems, providing a comprehensive grasp of this vital part of security and monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Design of a Miniaturized Antenna at GPS Band with Meander Slot Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this study, the use of the meander slot technique in a microstrip patch antenna for frequency reduction is examined. The antenna, which was designed to function at 2.4 GHz, is resonant at 1.54 GHz because to the deliberate addition of a meander slots. In order to attain the intended frequency shift while preserving the antenna’s fundamental properties—such as radiation efficiency and compactness—the meander slot approach is utilized. The success of the meander slot technique in attaining the frequency reduction is demonstrated by the paper’s thorough study of the design, modeling, and results. The proposed technique is having miniaturization factor of 65 percentage which is a very good result. For applications that demand lower operating frequencies without sacrificing overall antenna performance, the suggested method presents a viable option.

articleTitle: Design and Defect Analysis of C17 Benchmark Circuit using QCA and HDL
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Quantum dot Cellular Automata (QCA) is an emerging technology in the field of Nanotechnology and can be an important replacement of Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) technique. Currently CMOS technology is dominating the world of IC fabrication. But CMOS has its major drawback for the leakage current. QCA has the full potential to replace CMOS technology in future. It has ultra-high speed of operation (in THz) and very low power dissipation. In this paper, C17 benchmark circuit design is being proposed using the QCADesigner simulation Tool. This paper also models the defects that can be present in the circuit if not properly synthesized. The defects are analysed using a hardware descriptive language (i.e. VHDL and Verilog). The HDL models are being made using the ModelSim tool and the Xilinx Vivado Software. This paper shows the analysis of a combinational circuit in terms of power, area, energies and polarization. The paper also discusses about the faults that might occur at subsequent stages of the circuit.

articleTitle: Transforming E-Commerce: Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) Integration for Interactive and Immersive Shopping Experiences
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The e-commerce enterprise is undergoing a profound transformation through the integration of augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) technologies. This research paper explores the modern effect of AR and VR on e-trade web sites, ushering in a new technology of interactive and immersive online shopping. AR and VR technology empower customers to engage with merchandise in exceptional ways. Augmented truth offers users the ability to visualize merchandise in their real-international surroundings, offering a tangible revel in that bridges the gap between online and offline purchasing. Virtual fact, alternatively, transports users to virtual buying environments, creating a sensory-wealthy exploration of merchandise akin to an in-store experience. This paper delves into the myriad AR and VR functions improving e-commerce, together with virtual shopping, interactive 3D product fashions, and immersive storytelling. Personalization takes middle ground as AI-pushed recommendation engines examine user behavior to offer tailor-made product pointers, improving consumer engagement and conversion fees. Social trade integration permits users to create and share AR/VR-primarily-based content material, influencing the buying choices of their social circles. Moreover, this research addresses the essential elements of comfy charge processing and seamless checkout, instilling self-belief, and minimizing cart abandonment charges. As AR glasses and VR headsets grow to be handier, the integration of AR and VR into e-commerce is poised to reshape the industry panorama. This paper gives valuable insights for e-trade corporations and researchers into harnessing the capability of AR and VR to deliver brilliant, personalized, and at ease online purchasing reports.

articleTitle: Exploration of Image Segmentation: A Comprehensive Review of Traditional Segmentation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In recent years, Image processing techniques have gained increased significance across a broad range of applications concerning computer technology. The digital image is processed by applying a set of algorithms this process is called Digital Image Processing. Segmentation of an image is an essential action in the method of object identification in digital image processing. The overall image is segmented into various regions so that their information can be utilized to classify different elements in an image. The visual perception quality depends upon the type of segmentation. For tasks like recognizing and categorizing various items in an image, segmentation is essential. Its applications are vast, and its importance lies in its ability to provide precise and detailed information for a wide range of tasks. The fundamental idea of this paper is to review the notion of different digital Image segmentation techniques. The literature review provides a comprehensive overview of previous studies, highlighting their methodologies, strengths, and limitations, and serves as a foundation for the current study.

articleTitle: Development and Evaluation of a User-Friendly and Lightweight Weather Map Application: Enhancing Access to Real-Time Meteorological Data
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The construction of an interactive and dynamic weather map application utilising Hypertext Markup Language (HTML), Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), JavaScript, and Leaflet.js is shown in this research paper. This application’s main goal is to give users access to global real-time meteorological data, which includes temperature, humidity, wind speed, and air quality index (AQI). Users have the option of searching for a specific place or just clicking on a point of interest on the map to obtain this info. The programme makes use of the OpenWeatherMap API to retrieve and show current meteorological data, improving user access to weather data. The application’s philosophy, implementation, and technological foundation are discussed in this article, with an emphasis on the application’s potential for usage in the real world and the importance of providing users with useful meteorological data.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Personalized Comparison of Online Products Based on Price and Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The paper aims to provide a user-friendly and efficient way in order to compare prices of products across different e-commerce websites. The work has utilized web scraping techniques using Selenium and Chrome Driver to gather price data from various online retailers. The platform will also incorporate a personalized approach to the comparison process, allowing users to create custom product lists and receive notifications when the price of an item drops below a specified threshold. The personalized price comparison work will offer a valuable tool for consumers who are looking for the best deals on products without having to spend hours searching through multiple websites.

articleTitle: Leveraging Thermal Sensing Drones for Overheating Issue Mitigation in Remote Renewable Energy Installations
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The basic objective of this project centers on the creation of a thermal sensing drone designed to detect and mitigate overheating issues in remote renewable energy installations. In addition to this primary goal, the study includes three significant secondary objectives: first, the exploration of swarm technology to assess whether coordinated drone swarms offer extended flight capacity and more efficient data collection. Second, the investigation of edge computing for real-time data storage, transfer, and processing to enhance decision-making. Third, the examination of low-cost emergency landing pads to reduce drone damage during adverse weather conditions. By combining technology innovation, coordination, and practical solutions, this research strives to enhance the sustainability and efficiency of renewable energy infrastructure while addressing critical challenges in the field.

articleTitle: Enhancing Skin Disease Diagnosis Through Convolutional Neural Networks and YOLO v8 Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Skin disease detection and diagnosis has been overviewed as one of the most predominant challenges in this lousy and contaminated environment. Appropriate skin checking and disease detection can be a revolutionary outbreak in the medical science field. This leads to early discovery of any destructive skin diseases. Laser and photonic based medical technologies can help in the diagnosis, yet the scope of those tests is quite limited. Machine learning techniques contribute to enhancing robust frameworks capable of categorizing different classes of skin diseases. Within this context, Computer vision plays a crucial role employing various techniques for the effective detection of skin diseases in. This work contributes to the research of early detection of skin diseases. An image processing-based method is proposed in this work. The method takes digital images of the affected area and use image analysis to identify the type of disease. Our approach is fast, accurate, easily available, simple, and cost-effective. After proper analysis, the results are shown to the user including type of disease and severity. The system successfully detects 8 distinct types of skin diseases with an average accuracy of 80-90%.

articleTitle: Three factor chaotic map based efficient authentication scheme for smart healthcare systems
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Adoption of IoT in healthcare is called Internet of Medical Things(IoMT). IoMT along with device intelligence are helping to realize the concept of smart healthcare. IoMT contains several different type of medical sensors mounted on the patient's body to collect health parameters at defined frequency and transmits to the medical server $MS$ for long term retention and data analytics. This data is accessed by medical professionals using smart terminal connected to $MS$ through insecure channel communication channel. Health related data is both sensitive and critical and any authorized access or manipulation may lead to endanger patient's life. Hence providing secure access and privacy protection of this data is utmost important. Only few literature proposed to address security needs for IoMT. However, most of the protocols in literature fails to resist known attacks and to provide security features for this context. To address this issue, we propose secure and lightweight mutual authentication protocol using Chebyshev Chaotic Map and symmetric key encryption.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machine Model For Identification And Classification of Various Transmission Line Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The article presents a thorough investigation into the realm of fault identification and classification of transmission lines for a reliable and stable power system operation. With the growing demand for efficient electrical energy transmission, the identification and prompt rectification of faults in transmission lines have become imperative to prevent some catastrophic consequences. Therefore, developing a robust and accurate fault detection model is very crucial to maintain the integrity of power grids. In this article various machine learning models have been developed to find most accurate identification of different types of fault and a detail examination with analysis has been introduced. It is seen support vector machine (SVM) model works more superior than other machine learning models and accuracy has been reached more than ninety-nine percent which has been appreciated through corresponding confusion matrix, regression model and statistical analysis.

articleTitle: Applications of Machine Learning Techniques in Macroeconomic Analysis – A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This literature review examines a curated selection of articles featured in prominent economics journals and conferences. These publications showcase instances where machine learning (ML) tools have been employed in the realms of economics and econometric research. The emphasis of this survey is on elucidating the utilization of Machine Learning models and techniques within the field of economics, specifically addressing their application in economic contexts. The study delves into the utilization of Machine Learning and Deep Learning tools and techniques, particularly in handling non-traditional and unstructured data. The focus is on capturing robust nonlinearity with the overarching goal of enhancing prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Material Studies of Electro-Homeopathy Canceroso-1 Remedy to Correlate Clinical Properties
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Electro-Homeopathy is a Spagyric based herbal medical science, containing sixty exclusive remedies. The remedies are divided into nine groups containing specified group members. Canceroso-1 (C1) is the initial member of Canceroso Group. This remedy is made by the synergic combination of the spagyric essences of five specified plants, extracted by alchemical scientific processes. Each plant contains the active principle of their own. The resultant clinical properties of C1 on the affective diseased organ works on the tissue of Nose, Throat, Stomach, RT and Uterus. On an application the resultant synergic properties cover and control the affected organ and group of organs. The clinical properties of C1 depends upon the resultant medicinal properties related to properties of the material effectively. Here, the material properties have been successfully explored and correlated by FTIR and ED XRF respectively.

articleTitle: Recommendation System to Predict Best Academic Program
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Schools in India have multiple educational paths however it is a hassle to choose the proper path because here the performance of the students determines which education path they should join in the future and not their interests. This paper aims to propose a recommendation system that would predict the most suitable path for a student in their future ventures by utilizing the collaborative filtering approach. The system is designed to be easy to use and can adapt to different needs. By combining helpful suggestions with learning support, in this paper we aim to improve the overall learning experience for everyone. Our paper also deals with how we took care of major challenges including limited data, environment stability, and function implementation struggles with smart solutions. In addition to this approach, we also explored significant emerging solutions including advanced feature engineering and Natural Language Processing which has the potential to enhance our system positively in the future. Our system prioritizes the students’ choices carving a new road in the future of educational history.

articleTitle: A novel anaemia biosensor based on 2D photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: A 2D photonic crystal based on triangular lattice structure has been designed for anaemia diagnosis. The optical biosensor has been proposed with the aim of improvement in healthcare diagnostics. Anaemia is a condition which involves low haemoglobin concentration in blood and is a global concern. Hence, early and accurate detection of anaemia is very important. The proposed biosensor works on the concept of creating narrow passband within a specific photonic bandgap of a photonic crystal where a defect has been incorporated. Blood sample of an anaemia affected patient has been used as a point defect within the photonic crystal. The proposed biosensor is expected to immensely benefit anaemia patients as it will help in timely intervention.

articleTitle: Analysis on Enhancing Financial Decision-making Through Prompt Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This research investigates the transformative impact of prompt engineering on financial decision-making processes, addressing inefficiencies within the financial sector. Employing a mixed-method approach integrating quantitative analysis, qualitative insights, and literature review, the study assesses prompt engineering’s role in enhancing operational efficiency, risk management, and customer service. Quantitative evaluation pre- and post-prompt engineering implementation reveals a reduction in trade execution time, risk assessment accuracy substantially increasing, a significant improvement in customer response times, and a substantial enhancement in portfolio returns. These findings signify prompt engineering’s pivotal role as a catalyst for operational streamlining, refined risk assessment, enhanced customer-centric services, and optimized investment strategies. Moreover, the study emphasizes the critical need for ethical considerations and regulatory alignment in integrating prompt engineering responsibly. Ultimately, this research underscores prompt engineering’s potential to reshape financial processes, emphasizing its instrumental role in driving efficiency, risk management, and customer-centricity within the financial domain.

articleTitle: A New Nonisolated Bidirectional DC-DC Converter with High Voltage Conversion Ratio
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This article presents a new nonisolated bidirectional dc-dc converter (BDC) with high voltage conversion ratio and continuous input current. High voltage gain is achieved without using an isolation transformer or coupled inductor. The proposed converter is capable of providing high step-up gain (>10) while the duty ratio exceeds 0.5. Operating at a relatively lower duty ratio avoids drawbacks like inductor core saturation and switch conduction loss. Operating principle is discussed to explain bidirectional power flow. Steady state analysis is performed to derive the voltage conversion ratios of the proposed converter. A comparative analysis between the proposed topology and existing BDC topologies is presented in this article. Simulation results are presented to validate the steady state performance of the proposed converter.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Based Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Hand gesture recognition procedure is a computer vision technique that allows computers to recognize human hand gestures. This can be used for a variety of applications, such as controlling devices, providing feedback, and interacting with virtual reality environments. This paper proposes a novel approach to hand gesture recognition methodology using Python scripts and cv2 (OpenCV), media pipe, and time libraries. The proposed approach uses the Mediapipe library in order to detect as well as track hand landmarks in real time. The number of fingers raised is then calculated based on the detected hand landmarks. A message is then displayed on the screen based on the number of fingers detected and even a message is sent to a registered phone number. The proposed approach was evaluated using a set of data of hand gesture images. The results showed that the proposed approach was able to accurately recognize the number of fingers raised with an accuracy of 90%. The proposed approach exhibits novelty to hand gesture recognition that is simple to implement and can be used for a variety of applications. The approach is relatively accurate, making it a promising technique for hand gesture recognition.

articleTitle: Effect of Magnetic Field on Flow Behaviour of Blood Through a Modelled Atherosclerotic Artery
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this analytical study a mathematical model is developed to study the effect of stenosis on flow behaviour of the streaming blood through an atherosclerotic artery in the presence of magnetic field. The non-Newtonian character of blood is taken into account using a Casson fluid model of the blood. The coupled differential equations governing the MHD flow of blood are solved by a combined use of analytical and numerical techniques in the appropriate boundary conditions. The geometry of the asymmetric shape of the stenosis assumed to be manifested in the arterial segment is given due consideration in the analysis. An extensive quantitative analysis is performed through large scale numerical computations of the measurable flow variables having more physiological significance by developing computer codes. Some important observations having medical interest in the flow of the blood in the stenosed (constricted) arteries are obtained.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Review: Security Challenges and Countermeasures for Big Data Security in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: As big data becomes increasingly prevalent in the cloud computing, ensuring the security of data becomes paramount. This comprehensive review paper explores the security challenges and countermeasures associated with big data security in cloud computing environments. Through a thorough analysis of existing literature, the paper identifies key security issues including confidentiality, data authentication, data availability, privacy, data location, data storage, and data integrity. It reviews related works on cloud computing and big data security, highlighting gaps and limitations in current research. The paper proposes solutions to address the identified security challenges, such as encryption, access control, and Data Obfuscation. This review paper provides valuable insights into the security challenges and their current solutions for ensuring big data security in cloud computing, underscoring the importance of robust security measures in protecting data in cloud environments.

articleTitle: Implemented global model for brain tumor detection using Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Brain tumor (BT) is a severe medical issue that is challenging to detect and treat. For a few decades, there has been interest in applying machine learning and deep learning models to automate BT diagnosis. However, patients’ medical data is generally sensitive, and employing these models for BT diagnosis creates privacy problems. To overcome the issue mentioned above, federated learning (FL) architecture considers automating BT diagnosis. The proposed architecture develops and evaluates a global model using FL for BT identification. Using Backpropagation and DenseNet architecture, a model is designed for the MRI images and efficiently detects tumors for the patient. This approach uses a convolutional neural network to train a model on each device locally. The local models are combined to develop a global model to identify BT that allows clinics to transmit sensitive information while remaining anonymous. The results demonstrated that the framework accurately classified BT with good clinical accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Logical Review of CNTFET-based Ternary Universal Gates
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Multi-valued logic is favorable option to the binary logic due to low interconnection complexity and high transmission rate. The paper describes the evolution and benefits of ternary universal gate. Ternary logic gates provide several advantages over binary logic gates, including low power dissipation, faster processing, and lower complexity. The current research in ternary logic gates and continued developments in CNTFET technology, these gates play a significant role in future digital circuits. This research paper provides a comprehensive overview of CNTFET-based ternary universal gates, covering existing designs, performance measurements, and future applications.

articleTitle: Optimizing Urban Mobility: A Comprehensive Framework for Smart Parking Systems Integration Using IoT and Sensor Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Smart Parking Systems have gained prominence as a pivotal component of urban infrastructure, addressing the persistent challenge of limited parking spaces in burgeoning cities. This abstract delves into the evolution and functionality of Smart Parking Systems.
