Leveraging technology such as microcontroller, sensors, IoT, and data analytics, these systems optimize parking space utilization and enhance the overall parking experience. By providing real-time information to drivers, reducing traffic congestion, and minimizing environmental impact, they contribute to more sustainable urban development. This paper explores the various components and benefits of smart parking systems, showcasing their potential to revolutionize urban mobility and improve quality of life. As cities continue to grow, smart parking systems offer a promising solution to the parking conundrum, fostering a smarter, more efficient, and eco-friendly urban environment.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of Wind Power Forecast System Using AI Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The increasing demand for renewable energy sources, coupled with the intermittent nature of wind power, has led to the need for accurate wind power forecasting systems. This paper presents an in-depth investigation into the application of artificial intelligence (AI) approaches in developing a robust wind power forecast system. “Performance Enhancement of Wind Power Forecast Model Using Novel Pre-processing Strategy and Hybrid Optimization Approach.” this work focuses on improving the accuracy of wind power forecasting models, considering the increasing significance of wind energy due to environmental concerns and energy crises. As wind power generation is influenced by variability, accurate forecasting becomes essential for effective planning, operation, and control of power systems. The primary objective of the study is to enhance the accuracy of wind power predictions through innovative preprocessing techniques and a hybrid optimization algorithm. The proposed approach integrates data augmentation, feature extraction, and optimization to achieve improved forecasting results. The proposed hybrid optimization approach is the combination of two optimization algorithms, such as AO and SSA, for feature selection. The hybrid optimization approach effectively chooses the most pertinent features for WPF by combining these two methods. From the selected features the EHNM Model is suggested for WPF. An EHNM Model, which combines a CNN, LSTM network model, and an O-ANN, is used to forecast wind power. The main part of the ensemble is an O-ANN, which is trained using the best features chosen and then fine-tuned using a hybrid optimization approach (AO+SSA). The weighted mean of the three deep learning classifiers—the LSTM network model, CNN, and O-ANN—makes up the wind power forecast result.

articleTitle: A Robotic Approach for Detecting Alive Human Beings during Conflict Situation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The robotic car is designed for high-risk environments, employing a dual sensor system with Passive Infrared (PIR) and ultrasonic sensors. It distinguishes between alive and non-alive entities, triggering alerts and a 30-second pause for any instant actions, on detecting alive human beings. While simply acting as an obstacle detector if a non-living entity is detected, where it utilizes its ultrasonic sensors to navigate, turning right if space is available, left if not, and backwards if not even in the front. In cases of no available space, the robot continuously rotates 360 degrees. This versatile design finds applications in search and rescue operations, military reconnaissance, border patrol and security, offering precise and timely responses in dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle for District Surveillance with Computer Vision and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: It is a very challenging task to identify and trace the class of the objects during the time of poor visible conditions such as night time. Due to which there remains a gap in security measures especially in the areas where infiltration is a major issue and also the aerial activities are not that easy. In order to solve this issue, the study is conducted which uses Machine Learning and Computer Vision for the image and the video processing and also for the detection and the classification. The study is performed with the images and the video that are captured by the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) during night time where onwards Computer Vision and Machine Learning are used for the further classifications.

articleTitle: Screening of Autism Spectrum Disorder using Machine Learning Approach in Accordance with DSM-5
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a specific category of neurodevelopmental disorder that can be associated with several behavioral conditions and has no known cure to date. ASD can be detected from a very early stage in childhood and upon successful detection can be ameliorated. There have been several clinical diagnosis procedures and they can be error-prone and time-consuming. Thus, machine learning-based prediction models for early-stage ASD as well as in adolescents and adults are being developed over the years. In our study, several parameters of ASD detection were implemented with open-source ASD datasets and analysed using several machine learning models like Logistic regression, XGboost, SVC and Naive Bayes. Among these XGboost showed the best performance. The outcomes of such analytical approaches demonstrate that, when suitably optimized, machine-learning techniques can offer robust predictions of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) status. These findings imply that it may be feasible to employ these models for the early ASD detection, thereby enhancing the prospects of timely and effective intervention. XGBoost has given best results throughout all datasets, including cross validation. An accuracy of 100% has been achieved, making the model best for prediction.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Clarity in Real Time: An Automated Gamma Correction Approach for Dehazing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Haze is a natural occurrence resulting from the scattering of unwanted particles in the atmosphere, leading to issues such as color distortion, decreased contrast, and diminished visual appeal in outdoor images. However, computer vision applications necessitate clear images for effective processing. This study proposes a simple and fast image dehazing technique that reduces time complexity by employing gamma correction with a dark channel prior-based technique. This reduction in time complexity enables real-time application. The proposed method enhances image contrast through automatically adjusts brightness levels using gamma correction method where the gamma value is calculated based on the average pixel value of the gray scale image and contrast modification technique to enhance the image quality to suit the image requirements. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method produces higher-quality images compared to existing technologies. The combination of gamma correction and contrast limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization proves to be an effective approach for image enhancement and dehazing tasks, resulting in improved contrast and finer details across various image types. Comparative analysis based on parameters such as SSIM, MSE, PSNR, and Correlation confirms the competitive performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Examination of Interface Trap Charges on Electrically Doped Tunnel FET in the Presence of High-K Dielectric
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this article, we delve into a comparative analysis involving the dual material bipolar-gate electrically doped-tunnel FET (DMBG-EDTFET) and two proposed devices: the hetero-materials DMBG-ED-TFET (HM-DMBG-ED-TFET) and the high-K dielectric DMBG-ED-TFET (HD-DMBG-ED-TFET). The HM-DMBG-ED-TFET incorporates Si-Ge material at the source side and silicon on the drain and channel, while the HD-DMBG-ED-TFET employs a high-K dielectric ($\left.HfO_{2}\right)$ for its oxide layer, resulting in an observed enhancement in the ON current. However, the HM-DMBG-ED-TFET exhibits limitations in analog and RF performance, a critical concern for circuitry and radio frequency-related applications. Additionally, we explore the impact of ITCs (interface traps and charges) on these devices, aiming to address reliability issues. This investigation involves analyzing the effects of ITCs on various aspects, including electrical characteristics, linearity and distortion parameters have been carried out for low distortion and high-frequency performance investigation of the device.

articleTitle: Design and development of Dual wide band Frequency Selective Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This work reveals the Design and development of Dual wide band frequency selective surfaces (FSS). Dual-band FSS based on single and multi layers with or without or extra discrete components has been discussed and analyzed. Dual wide band-pass FSSs has been designed and developed by using two metallic layers for the wide targeted pass band frequency bands range of 3.53-5.3 GHz and 3.53-4.21 GHz. In the initial step of Development ultra thin double layer slotted FSS has been used. These generate resonance at 4.0 GHz and 4.8 GHz. Furthermore Hilbert shaped slotted resonator increase pass band width enhancement. Lastly the opposite alignment of similar FSS metallic plate to form the proposed dual layer FSS which exhibit the bandwidth enhancement of the frequency bands.

articleTitle: Design of a Flexible Multiband Antenna with Frequency Reconfigurable Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This work presents a compact coplanar micro-strip line fed flexible multiband frequency reconfigurable antenna. The proposed antenna is backed by a flexible kapton polyamide substrate (with dielectric constant 3.4 and loss tangent 0.002) having dimensions of 30 mm × 30 mm and a thickness of 0.5 mm. A rectangular ring with outer dimensions of 15 mm × 8 mm embedded with two parallel rectangular strip is chosen as the radiating patch of the antenna. A triple band operation of the antenna (with PIN and Varctor diode is off) is achieved at the centre frequency of 6.1 GHz, 9.3 GHz and 12.97 GHz which is suitable for WLAN and Satellite communication. The two PIN diodes are incorporated in between the two rectangular strip and rectangular ring to tune the antenna in two modes, including a triple band mode (when the diodes are in off state) with the centre frequency at 6.1 GHz, 9.3 GHz and 12.97 GHz which is suitable for WLAN and Satellite communication and a dual band mode (when the diodes are in on state) with the centre frequency at 3.5 GHz (5G sub 6 GHz band) and 9.8 GHz (X band). The frequency configurability in dual band is further obtained with the incorporation a Varactor diodes in the gaps of two rectangular radiating patches. Furthermore, the examined antenna exhibits remarkable resilience to performance degradation when subjected to bending effects, while also maintaining excellent impedance matching characteristics. This ensures that the antenna’s functionality remains largely unaffected even under adverse conditions and hence well suited for wearable body area network.

articleTitle: Enhancing Fake News Detection with Sentiment Analysis Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In the digital age we live in today, fake news has become a serious problem because it has the power to sway public opinion, affect policy decisions, and upend social harmony. Sentiment analysis, which evaluates the content’s emotional tone, is essential for spotting and stopping the spread of false information. In this work, we leverage machine learning techniques for sentiment analysis to increase the detection accuracy of fake news. To scrutinize the affective milieu present in news pieces and headlines, we investigate the amalgamation of various sentiment analysis instruments, such as VADER, TextBlob, and NLTK. By translating textual input into numerical properties, TF-IDF vectorization is utilized in conjunction with sentiment analysis to increase the predictive power of machine learning models. Enhancing the feature set through the use of TF-IDF vectorization is essential for teaching machine learning models to discern between authentic and fraudulent news. As classification models, Decision trees, SVM, and Logistic regression are used; each has advantages when it comes to processing tasks involving sentiment-based classification. In this study, we try to classify the emotions that the fake news mainly shows after the prediction. We have seen the trend that mainly Negative emotion is conveyed with fake news. The models have been compared and we’re getting 98% accuracy.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of RF Performance Investigating Novel OCSRR Embedded Triangle Antenna versus Triangle Slot Antenna for L Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This exploration delves into the radio frequency (RF) performance of a Novel Open Complementary Split Ring Resonator (OCSRR) embedded in a triangle antenna, compared with a triangle slot antenna, tailored for L-band applications at 1.8 GHz on a $50 \Omega$ characteristic impedance. Metrics like return loss, gain, and VSWR were evaluated, with 34 measurements collected. The Novel OCSRR Embedded triangle antenna demonstrated superior performance, boasting a return loss of 24.1400, gain of 2.42, and VSWR of 1.0799. In contrast, the triangular slot antenna exhibited -17.5379 return loss, 1.208 gain, and 1.3062 VSWR. Both antennas shared 85mm by 80mm dimensions. Statistical analysis emphasized the significance of results ($\mathrm{p}\lt 0.05)$. This investigation establishes the OCSRR Embedded triangle antenna as a superior choice for enhanced RF performance over the triangle slot antenna, offering valuable insights for L-band applications. The findings contribute to advancing antenna design for improved communication and signal processing in relevant frequency bands.

articleTitle: Boron Doping of Tin-Catalyzed VLS Grown Silicon Nanowires on Cu Substrate Using Hot Wire Assisted Chemical Vapor Deposition
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this study, we concentrate on the growth of tin (Sn)-catalyzed boron-doped silicon nanowires (SiNWs) on copper (Cu) substrates via hot wire-assisted chemical vapor deposition (HWCVD). In order to improve the efficiency of batteries and thermoelectric devices, doped SiNWs grown directly on Cu can prove to be very helpful because of the high conductivity of Cu substrate. Utilizing silane (SiH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) and diborane (B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>) during the formation of SiNWs allows for the boron doping of these nanowires. From SEM, the boron-doped SiNWs are observed at a low B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> to SiH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> flow ratio (0.1 to 0.4) and the SiNWs do not grow at a high B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> to SiH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> flow ratio of 0.5 for Sn catalyst of 55 nm diameter. The core-shell structure of boron-doped SiNWs have been observed by TEM. Additionally, it has been noted that the density of doped SiNWs decreases by increasing Sn catalyst size to 55 nm at B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> to SiH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> flow ratio ≥ 0.5. Here, the focus is on altering the doping concentration and template size to control the doping and density of SiNWs on the Cu substrate.

articleTitle: Long-Short Term Memory Based Stock Market Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Stock market Prediction has been a source of much interest and challenge in financial markets for a long time. In this study we shall investigate the use of long term and short term memory network (LSTM), a type of Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) for stock market forecasting. Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) has shown promising results in time series analysis. They have the ability to learn long term dependencies in time series data, making them well suited for modeling the temporal patterns of stock prices. The main aim of this project is to predict the stock price trend in the future according to various time frame and factor with accuracy and robustness of the Long Short Term Memory(LSTM) model and also to find the performances indices such as Mean Standard Error(MAE) and Root Mean Square Error(RMSE).The basic Novelty of this design of the Long Short Term Memory(LSTM) model in our work is that it ensures a minimum level of time and space complexity and the model can make highly accurate and precision predictions from a large dataset and is not affected much by fluctuations due to the root mean square and mean absolute error algorithms present in the design.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic Properties of Ag-Au Co-doped LiNbO3 Studied by First-Principles Generalized Gradient Approximation + U Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The electronic and optical properties of pure and Ag-Au co-doped lithium niobate crystals are calculated by using density functional theory (DFT). The obtained results indicate that lithium niobate exhibits a non-magnetic semiconducting nature. The co-doping percentage of 8.33% did not change the semiconducting nature of the crystal. However, a significant reduction in the band gap was found in the co-doped structure. For both pure and co-doped structures, the optical properties including dielectric function, refractive index, extinction coefficient, and reflectivity were calculated and thoroughly examined.

articleTitle: Circular Polarization of a Printed Monopole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Printed Monopole Antennas are popular due to their large impedance bandwidth and also has Omni-directional radiation pattern in one plane. Most of the work that has been done on printed monopole antennas were having linear polarization for the entire impedance bandwidth, not much significant work was carried out to achieve Circular Polarization. In this work, a printed monopole antenna is specifically designed and optimized for Circular Polarization. The antenna is printed on a low-cost and readily available FR-4 substrate. The design process involves consideration of the antenna's geometry, feed structure, and ground plane dimensions to achieve desired characteristics. Simulated results demonstrate the antenna's suitability for its intended frequency band, with considerations for Axial Ratio, Bandwidth, Radiation pattern, and Impedance bandwidth, which are analysed for its implementation in wireless communication systems. The proposed antenna gives an axial ratio bandwidth of 1.2 GHz around the center frequency of 5.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Predicting Customer Satisfaction of Luxury Watches Using ID3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: It is generally believed that luxury watches are bought by the rich and elite as a status symbol. But customer satisfaction is crucial for repeat buying, the customer base being comparatively small. The aim of the study was to find out the factors on the basis of which customer satisfaction can be predicted and the hierarchy in which these factors impact customer satisfaction. Information was collected from the customers of the luxury watch division of Pantaloons, Junction Mall in Durgapur, West Bengal. First exploratory factor analysis was used to identify the factors impacting the satisfaction level. The factors identified were Performance, Design, Quality, Marketing Efforts, and Concern For Status. The ID3 decision tree algorithm was used to classify the customers into three levels high satisfaction, moderate satisfaction, and low satisfaction with their purchase. Confusion matrix and ROC curve were used for downscaling the robustness of the model. The overall accuracy of the model was 89.47%.

articleTitle: Success Rate Analysis of Students in MOOC Credit Courses through Supervised Learning Algorithms under Professional Discipline
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The present work explicitly deals with the success rate prediction of students while opting MOOC Credit courses for various professional domains following AICTE guideline. As the four-year professional courses are subcategorized in basic science, humanities, core engineering, professional elective, and free elective; therefore, mapping of courses for success rate evaluation are performed for all the sectors for a consecutive eight batches where choice of candidates are monitored using different supervised learning algorithms. Result reflects a distinct pattern of success in nontechnical areas as well as in free and professional electives, whereas core engineering suffers a lot, owing to the major consideration of programming related courses, as evident from the results obtained through various supervised learning techniques. Comparative study is carried out based on F1 score, TP, TN, FP, FN; and regression analysis is found the best adopted technique for the same. Only SWAYAM NPTEL courses are considered for the evaluation following the guideline published in India Gazette. Artificial intelligence powered customized learning enhances the course enrollment rate as it augments re-designing and evaluation methodologies based on previous performances. Statistical findings provide improved direction about the mode of future learning, which is partially reflected in NEP 2020.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework for Forensic Bone Age Estimation Using CNN Architecture and Multimodal Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This study introduces an approach to forensic bone age estimation by employing a multimodal fusion strategy within a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture. The challenge of low-quality images in the dataset is addressed through the incorporation of the Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) preprocessing technique, effectively enhancing image quality and bolstering model accuracy. Furthermore, efficient net transfer learning techniques are implemented for additional refinement. The validation of the proposed method, assessed using Mean Squared Error (MSE) and the coefficient of determination $R^{2}$ score, demonstrates compelling results with an MSE value of 18.21 and an $R^{2}$ score of 0.59. These outcomes surpass those of existing methods, highlighting the superior accuracy and robustness of our framework. This marks a significant advancement in forensic bone age estimation.

articleTitle: An Integrated Framework for Smart Monitoring of Orange Orchard
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Oranges hold significant sway in the global food market, making the monitoring of their production a matter of utmost importance. Keeping track of the production procedure is the most important part of having a great yield of oranges. Through the integration of cloud computing, IoT, machine learning, and advanced image analysis techniques, we aim to streamline orange orchard management. Machine learning and computer vision have brought revolutionary changes to the agricultural sector, particularly in orchard monitoring. This paper introduces an integrated framework for orchard monitoring, focusing on real-time imaging of oranges, cloud-based storage, and the application of machine learning algorithms for automated monitoring and yield notifications to farmers. Additionally, we have conducted a comparative analysis of various machine learning models to evaluate their capacity to detect and count overlapped oranges within the dataset. Our proposed framework encompasses image capture, cloud storage, and machine learning analysis, providing farmers with invaluable insights into orange production. The comparative analysis delves into the merits and limitations of different machine learning models, including the K-means and Distance Least Square, Hough Transform, and YOLOv3, addressing the challenge of detecting overlapped oranges.

articleTitle: A Framework for Human Activity Recognition using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) has gained significant importance in various fields, including healthcare, surveillance, and human-computer interaction. In this study, we comprehensively study the related work done in the past to enhance HAR system. We have also studied the various benchmark datasets that can be employed to detect diverse human activities. The basis CNNs capture distinct features and representations. Through a combination of their predictions, our ensemble model is expected to achieve superior performance on a wide range of human activities. A case study which employs pretrained CNN demonstrates the effectiveness of CNNs in improving HAR performance and highlights the potential for real-world applications. In the last section, A framework for HAR that leverages the power of ensemble Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) is also proposed to enhance recognition accuracy and robustness. This framework paves the way for more accurate and reliable human activity recognition systems in practical scenarios.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm Based Feature Selection and Optimized Edge Detection for Brain Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for brain tumor detection using Steady-State Genetic Algorithms for filter optimization and feature selection. The proposed method utilizes two genetic algorithms to select relevant features and optimize filter coefficients. A genetic algorithm is employed to select a subset of features using random forest as the fitness evaluator. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the method in accurately detecting brain tumors with reduced computational complexity. Subsequently, another genetic algorithm is employed in which the initial population of fractional order filters is evaluated using ideal edge images, and the top-performing filters undergo crossover and mutation operations. After several generations, the filters with the highest fitness values are selected as optimized filter coefficients. The integration of genetic algorithms with brain tumor detection shows promise for optimizing filters and selecting informative features, improving clinical decision-making.

articleTitle: Current Trends in Financial Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Predicting the prices of stocks is a complex challenge that has attracted the interest of both investors and computer scientists. This review paper delves into the realm Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning techniques employed in the past few years to construct effective models for predicting stock prices. It categorizes a range of linear and non-linear machine learning algorithms, neural network architectures, data sources, and commonly utilized metrics for assessing research outcomes. The paper also examines the methods of implementation and assesses their reproducibility. Furthermore, it provides a summary of technical papers and offers concise descriptions of each one. The overarching aim of reviewing these technical papers is to explore the potential for retail investors to generate profits through day trading in the stock market using relatively modest computational resources at their disposal.

articleTitle: Cluster Quality in Agriculture: Assessing GDP and Harvest Patterns in Asia and Europe with K-Means and Silhouette Scores
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This study presents an analysis of global economies using K-Means clustering to classify countries based on their average Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and harvested area over multiple years (1980-2020). The objective was to identify distinct groupings that could inform economic and agricultural practices. The algorithm was set to two clusters, revealing a stark contrast between a large, diverse group of countries and a smaller cluster consisting exclusively of China and India. The first cluster included nations with a wide range of economic outputs and agricultural scales, whereas the second was characterized by significantly larger harvested areas. A scatter plot visualization demonstrated the clear separation between the clusters, emphasizing the unique economic and agricultural status of the two Asian giants. This clustering analysis not only highlights the disparities in global economic and agricultural profiles but also provides a quantitative basis for future strategic planning.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of MIMO Antenna at a frequency of 4.2 GHz
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In this work, a compact linearly polarizedMultiple-Input-Multiple-Output (MIMO) antenna system has been designed. The primary aim of the work is to minimize mutual coupling between antenna elements and enhance isolation for Wi-Fi applications. The system consists of two symmetrically designed printed microstrip antennas on a FR-4 printed circuit board. Using HFSS software, the proposed antenna is designed.

articleTitle: Securing the Skies: An UAV-Based Framework for Safe and Authenticated Product Delivery Using QR Codes
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Advancements in the field of Image processing, remotely controlled Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and battery technologies it has become a promising solution to the modern world when it comes to surveillance and product delivery. In this study a framework is designed with a UAV and Quick Response (QR) verification system where the route and the mission planning of the UAV are set by an operator using a computing device equipped with the UAV. Where onwards the UAV continue its mission and reaching to a particular delivery location the QR Scanner become online and upon successful scanning and verification the chamber gets opened and the product gets delivered. The UAV drone then continues to the next set of waypoints by following the same protocol. The drone ensures a smooth and effective mission execution by returning to its home location after completing the entire journey. The successful execution of the delivery task was greatly aided by the use of the QR verification method that employed in this study.

articleTitle: DroneMag: A Novel Approach Using Drone Technology for Detection of Magnetic Metal
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The study introduces an innovative approach to enhance the precision of metal-sensitive magnetometers used in unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The three-pronged strategy comprises of using lightweight drone bodies produced via 3D printing, elongated rods, and electrical shielding. The system’s primary objective is to enhance reading accuracy, especially in regions with volcanic activity, hence improving safety and efficiency. The study highlights the need of integrating magnetometer data with other geophysical methods in order to comprehend metal depositions. The technology has potential applications in the fields of environmental protection, infrastructure inspection, and archaeology. The suggested approach entails the integration of drones equipped with magnetometers to enhance safety, efficiency, and precision in conducting surveys inside a volcanic region. The quadrotor drone equipped with magnetometers is a significant advancement in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) technology. It provides autonomous navigation capabilities, a magnetic interference compensator and a real-time metal detecting sensor.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of High-Speed Voltage Level Shifter based on Wilson Current Mirror
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper presents the level shifter’s multi-supply voltage design. Voltage level shifters serve as an interface between the controller and high-voltage or power devices, as opposed to the voltage the controller supplies. The numerous design blocks that operate at varying supply voltages are bridged using level shifters. The suggested method offers a voltage level shifter that uses Wilson current mirror level shifters (WCMLS) built on reflected output. The suggested method eliminates the limitation of traditional WCMLS by using a current mirror with an exceptionally high aspect ratio, hence saving a large amount of area. Utilizing Cadence Virtuoso™ and HSpice™, WCMLS is developed for 180 nm CMOS technology with a 1.8 model of MOSFET. According to the simulation results, the developed model can efficiently convert a low input voltage level of 3.3 V to an output voltage of about 6.5 V. Total power consumption, delay, duty cycle, rise time, fall time, and slew rate for the proposed level shifter are 43.57 W, 40.1 ps, 50.3%, 25.3 ps, 46.5 ps, and 205G, respectively.

articleTitle: A MATLAB Expedition Into Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper deals with cutting-edge techniques in image processing, addressing critical aspects such as edge detection, noise cancellation, histogram analysis, image compression, and upgradation using MATLAB. Evaluating both traditional and deep learning approaches, the study explores methods to enhance image quality, reduce noise, optimize contrast through histogram manipulation, and implement efficient compression algorithms. MATLAB’s image processing toolbox facilitates the implementation and validation of these techniques, with results demonstrating significant improvements in various aspects of image enhancement. This research contributes a versatile toolkit for researchers, practitioners, and enthusiasts in the field of digital image processing, catering to diverse applications from medical imaging to computer vision.

articleTitle: Material Property Studies of Red Complex Electroids used as Electro-Homeopathy Remedies
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Electro Homeopathy contains remedies which are usually applicable for oral uses. There are six complex electroids are extensively useful for oral and therapeutic uses. Clinical properties of the Red electricity have been vividly studied but their materials properties so far not been explored. In this work the material properties are studied by Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy and Micro Energy dispersive X-RAY (ED-XRF) fluorescence. The correlation between the material properties and material properties have also been studied.

articleTitle: A Study on Device Properties of High Electron Mobility Transistors
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Electrical characteristics of Field Effect Transistors depend upon its mechanical structure of the device. It depends upon the dimension of the electrodes along with the electrical voltages applied to the electrodes. The electrical field generated in the device also depends upon the properties of the dielectric material used. High Electron Mobility Transistor (HEMT) is a special type of device. In this study, the properties of HEMT will be discussed. In HEMT, the mobility of electrons is enhanced with the help of heterojunction structure by trapping electron in the form of 2D Electron Gas with very high conductivity. The electrical properties of HEMT have been studied here by altering their physical dimensions, changing the doping concentration by replacing a suitable material to form proper heterojunction interface.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Shading Effect over PV Module using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The increasing adoption of solar energy systems necessitates a comprehensive understanding of factors influencing their efficiency. Shading is a critical aspect that can significantly impact the power output of solar modules. In this research, we employ deep learning techniques to quantify the effects of shading on solar module performance. By leveraging convolutional neural networks (CNNs) on dataset of solar module output collected from shaded and unshaded solar modules, we develop a model capable of accurately predicting the percentage of shading in real-time.The methodology involves simulation of solar modules to collect dataset under varying shading conditions. These dataset serves as input to the deep learning model, which is trained to recognize patterns indicative of shading. The trained model demonstrates robust performance in estimating shading percentages, providing a non-intrusive and efficient means of assessing the impact of shading on solar energy production.

articleTitle: Modeling And Linearization of Radio Frequency Power Amplifiers Using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper presents the application of contemporary machine learning algorithms to model and linearize the characteristics of Radio Frequency Power Amplifiers (RFPAs). RFPAs are required by wireless systems to increase the signal power for long-distance transmission. However, they cause signals with high peak-to-average power ratios (PAPR) to be distorted due to their inherent nonlinearity qualities and memory effects, raising bit-error rates (BER) in wireless systems. Hence, a key step in reducing signal distortion is linearising its behavioral features utilizing the digital pre-distortion (DPD) technique. Support vector regression (SVR) and Kernel regression (KR), two well-known kernel-based machine learning approaches, are used in this study to model and linearize RF PAs. The modeling and linearising capabilities of both techniques are demonstrated on a class AB GaN-based RFPA. It was found that linearising the RFPA characteristics using SVR with radial basis kernel function yields improved linearization performance compared to the kernel regression-based and standard memory polynomialbased method.

articleTitle: In-Situ X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy of size-selected Al-Nanoclusters on Si-Substrate
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Aluminium nanoclusters of 5.4 nm diameter was fabricated and then deposited on silicon wafer. The process of magnetron sputtering was employed in fabricating the clusters. The surface morphology along with the elemental composition of the films of Al-nanoclusters were studied using Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) and X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) analysis respectively. During the analysis, an average diameter of 6.5 nm was observed using the statistical distribution of nanoclusters on the substrates along with prominent peaks of Al 2s, Si 2p, and O 1s under full survey spectra of XPS.

articleTitle: An Ultra Low Power Process Compensated Current Source for MICS Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The paper presents the design, analysis and simulation results of an ultra low power process compensated current source for Medical Implant Communications Service band applications. The unique characteristics of the application make the current source temperature invariant. Voltage variations are eliminated by the use of a voltage regulator. The circuit consists of two beta multiplier references, one whose output current is controlled by NMOS parameters and another by PMOS parameters. Finally, a current summation network adds the current from the complementary beta multiplier references. Hence in skew corners the current variation is very minimal. For the non-skew corners, a trimming circuitry brings the current to the desired value. The current source has been designed using 180nm CMOS technology in Cadence and provides a current of $6 \mu \mathrm{A}$ while having a power consumption of $32.39 \mu \mathrm{W}$ from 1.6V power supply. The percentage variation of current in skew corners is 1.66 which is very low at such power consumption levels.

articleTitle: Resonator Method For Measuring Dielectric Permittivity of Gas Substance
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: A functional scheme for measuring the dielectric permittivity of plant gas substance was validated. A method for measuring dielectric permittivity of plant gas substance based on measuring changes in the resonant frequency of a measuring resonator, the method includes using the resonator device as a frequency discriminator. The use of a resonator device as a frequency discriminator determines the principle of construction of the frequency conversion system. In such a system, frequency conversion is based on frequency autotuning of a frequency-stabilized generator to the frequency of the measuring resonator.

articleTitle: IOT Based Home Security System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Our innovative IoT-based home security system, utilizing ESP-32 CAM module and Arduino IDE, seamlessly manages and enhances home security. By capturing real-time video and sending it to the user’s email, coupled with motion detection notifications, it provides an affordable and user-friendly solution. This technology-driven paradigm shift democratizes access to robust home security, showcasing our commitment to advancing residential safety.

articleTitle: Crystallinity and Optical Property Analysis of Magnetron Sputtered Carbon Nitride Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This research explores the synthesis and characterization of carbon nitride (CNx) thin films on copper coated tempered glass substrate through the in-house developed DC magnetron sputtering system at low operating power density of 3.4 W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Carbon nitride, a promising material with diverse applications ranging from optoelectronics to catalysis, has gathered significant attention due to its tunable properties and unique electronic structure. Magnetron sputtering, known for its precision and versatility, offers a controlled deposition method for fabricating CNx thin films. The study systematically investigates the influence of sputtering time at a fixed discharge current on the crystallographic and optical characteristics of the deposited films. Through a comprehensive analysis using techniques like X-ray diffraction, and UV-Vis spectroscopy, we elucidate the impact deposition time on the crystallographic structure, and optical bandgap of the resulting carbon nitride thin films.

articleTitle: Spectral Behavior Optimization of Uniform Fiber Bragg Grating-Inscribed in SMF-28 Fiber
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Fiber Bragg Gratings (FBGs) have gained significant attention in recent years due to their unique spectral behavior and potential applications in various fields. This research paper presents an optimization of three physical parameters of uniform FBGs in Single Mode Fiber (SMF) core, focusing on their spectral behavior. The study investigates important characteristic specifications of FBGs: grating refractive index, grating width, and the number of gratings. Through extensive simulations, optimal values for these parameters are determined. The investigation of these physical factors demonstrates how these elements have an impact on the bandwidth and center-wavelength of the reflected light. It is found that a grating width of $\Lambda / 2$, a grating refractive index of 1.4950, and 60 gratings result in a narrow-band spectral filter with a reflected band centered at the Bragg wavelength of 1565 nm.

articleTitle: Detection of induction motor faults: Through fuzzy logic and frequency analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Induction machines are widely used in industries. Thus, maintaining them becomes a cost-effective and productive solution for the success of such an industry. The detection method used in this paper is based on sidebands around the supply frequency in the stator current signal and vibration. The paper mainly focuses on how to localize such errors as broken rotor bar faults and other mechanical defects and the possible solutions through fuzzy inference systems

articleTitle: A New 22 nm ULPLS Architecture to Detect 70 mV Minimum Input, Suitable for IOT Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Modern applications such as energy harvesting, signal monitoring in bio-medical sensing, portable point of care devices, etc. which involve state of the art mixed signal subsystems require robust ultra low power operation. Here in this work, a novel ultra low power level shifter (ULPLS) is proposed for sensing voltage signals in sub-threshold region. The proposed architecture is implemented in 22 nm technology using a dual power supply. The high and low supply voltages $(\mathrm{V}_{ddH}$ & $\mathrm{V}_{ddL})$ are set as 0.8 V and 0.4 V respectively. The key design features of ULPLS include a current limiting PMOS diode, a voltage divider, and an enhanced pull up network. The ULPLS exhibits a low power dissipation of $\sim 22.84$ nW with a minimum $\sim 70$ mV detection of input signal. The robustness of the design has been examined via worst case and Monte Carlo analyses.

articleTitle: Development of GUI and Slot Booking System for Marine Vessel Charging
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The adoption of electric vessels (E-vessel) is becoming increasingly important in the global effort towards achieving a sustainable future for maritime transportation. To facilitate their growth, an efficient and user-friendly charging infrastructure is essential. The research proposes a ship charging solution featuring a graphical user interface (GUI) for monitoring and slot booking, an algorithm for slot allocation, and slot detection for effective management. Long Range Wide Area Network (LoRaWAN) ensures secure and reliable communication between the charging station and vessel. The system enables Evessels to check slot availability, book priority slots, and receive power based on demand. Real-time monitoring simplifies charging process management for operators. A web-based platform allows convenient remote access to the charging infrastructure, facilitating slot booking and monitoring. The system is designed to scale and integrate with other charging systems and future upgrades. Utilizing LoRaWAN ensures cost-effectiveness and reliability. The proposed system aims to reduce the carbon footprint of the maritime industry and support the growth of E-vessels, making it a sustainable and reliable solution for the future of maritime transportation.

articleTitle: Motion of Mobile Robots in Environments with Dynamic Obstacles and Arbitrary Directions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper presents an improved study on the motion of mobile robots with dynamic obstacle environments and arbitrary directions. This study focuses on incorporating the concept of inertia into the movement of obstacles to enhance the capabilities of mobile robots in complex environments. Unlike random movements, the obstacles in this study possess inertia, which constrains their motion in predictable patterns. This inertia can be learned or predicted by the robot, enabling it to better anticipate the obstacle positions. This research employs a grid-based simulation environment with systematically moving obstacles. By considering inertia, the robot gains the ability to understand and leverage the predictable aspects of obstacle motion, resulting in improved navigation performance. The robot can predict obstacle trajectories more effectively, reducing the likelihood of collisions and increasing overall efficiency by using the velocity obstacle algorithm. By incorporating inertia into the movement of obstacles, the robot gains valuable insights that enable it to plan its movements more intelligently. Incorporating inertia as a factor in obstacle motion contributes to a more systematic and predictable environment, allowing the robot to make informed decisions based on the anticipated positions of both fixed and moving obstacles. This research opens up possibilities for further advancements in mobile robot navigation in complex environments and dynamic scenarios.

articleTitle: The Role of Kalman Gain and Noise Covariance Selection on the Convergence in State Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In state estimation problems, the Kalman filter (KF) algorithm considers the noise in the measurements and the systems facilitating convergence to the true state. This paper presents the Bayesian derivation of the discrete-time KF algorithm for a simple example known as the random walk model. However, if the KF coefficients are not well-tuned, it can significantly impact the estimation accuracy and may lead to algorithmic inconsistency. The Kalman gain is a quantitative measure which plays a crucial role in achieving the optimum convergence and stability. In this study, we evaluate the importance of the Kalman gain in the KF algorithm across several choices of the error covariance within the context of the random walk model. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the optimal Kalman gain is determined by minimizing the mean squared error (MSE), producing an unbiased and efficient estimate. This adaptive adjustment enables the KF to tune parameters easily. The theoretical and numerical investigations were carried out using the random walk plus noise model.

articleTitle: Power Profile Smoothing of PV Power Plant with a Fuzzy Logic Controlled Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This study concentrates on the power profile smoothing of solar power plants (grid-connected) due to weather intermittency. A battery energy storage system (BESS) is introduced for the smoothing purpose. A fuzzy logic-based reference current generator of 45 rules is embedded for controlling the battery energy storage system. This system substantially helps develop a controllable renewable energy generation model. We aimed to minimize the natural crests and troughs found in the power generation curve of solar power plants while keeping the battery SOC within 50%. The real-time power generation curve was compared with a reference power curve. For generating the reference power curve we leveraged the Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT)-Model Predictive Control algorithm. At any particular location, the reference power curve was obtained from the forecasted irradiation and temperature of that day. Membership functions and rule base of the fuzzy logic-based controller are adjusted to obtain the power profile like the reference power generation curve. The obtained result is offline simulation-based and all the practical data was taken from Kaptai solar power plant (Lat:22.493286, Long: 92.218809), which was the first of its kind in Bangladesh.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Single Image Super-Resolution Benchmarking with Transfer Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In the context of real-world applications like medical imaging systems, tracking, astronomical imaging, navigation, and remote sensing (RS), there is a pressing need to enhance or upscale images with minimal errors. This is particularly critical for tasks such as target detection, image classification, and land use mapping. However, remote sensing images often suffer from limitations in spatial, spectral, radiometric, and temporal resolution due to complex atmospheric conditions and sensor constraints. Additionally, acquiring these images can be expensive and time-consuming. In this study, we propose a Single Image Super-Resolution (SISR) method to address these challenges by upscaling low-quality remote sensing images to higher resolution, enabling a better understanding of these images. We also discuss the specific challenges in remote sensing super-resolution techniques and review various upscaling approaches, while analyzing the impact of other factors like weather conditions, image capture time, and different scene types on the technique’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: Weed Segmentation: A Novel Dataset, Benchmark and YOLO Baseline
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Farm ecosystems are seriously threatened by woody weeds’ invasion of other plant species. In addition to shading out and replacing native flora, these invasive plants actively compete with primary agricultural plants for scarce resources including sunlight, water, air, and soil nutrients. Weeds have a negative effect on crop quality and productivity in a number of ways, including lower yields and lower overall production efficiency. In order to overcome this obstacle, new approaches are needed. One such approach is the development of large-scale, carefully annotated image collections that are specialized for weed identification in different cropping systems. Our work presents a fresh resource—the Weed Segmentation dataset—in answer to this requirement. Using this dataset, we create a baseline for classifying weeds and use advanced data-driven artificial intelligence models for weed detection. Of the models that were assessed, YOLOv5s is the model that performs the best, scoring the maximum 54.64% mAP@[0.5:0.95:0.05]. This notable result shows YOLOv5s as a strong baseline for the suggested dataset, which is a big step forward for precision agriculture and weed control.

articleTitle: Solar Flare Prediction Using Hybrid CNN-Model
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This paper introduces a hybrid convolutional neural network (CNN) approach to solve the issues given by unpredictable solar flares in space weather forecasting. The methodology, which uses the Solar Dynamics Observatory (SDO) benchmark dataset, combines the robust feature extraction capabilities of VGGNet-16 with the computational efficiency of LeNet. The SDO dataset’s input data is carefully preprocessed and shrunk to fit the input size of VGGNet-16, which processes the data to extract complex feature maps capturing minor solar activity patterns. These maps are then transformed to 32x32 to meet the input requirements of LeNet, enabling for accurate classification of solar flares into their appropriate classifications. The experimental results show that the hybrid CNN system outperforms standard approaches in terms of prediction accuracy. The combination of VGGNet-16 feature extraction with LeNet classification improves accuracy while also ensuring computational economy, which is critical for real-time applications. This study represents a big step forward in space weather forecasting, demonstrating the connection between deep learning and heliophysics. The suggested model advances our understanding of solar phenomena by exposing complex patterns underlying solar flares and bridging the gap between observational data and computer models. The discovery holds potential for real-time space weather monitoring, which is critical for satellite operations and terrestrial communication systems. The methodology’s efficacy highlights its potential for enhancing astrophysical data processing and space weather forecasting skills, emphasizing the synergy between the technological advancement and scientific research in the field of astrophysics.

articleTitle: Automatic Anesthesia Based On Real Time Heart Beat
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This research investigates the feasibility and efficacy of an automated anesthesia delivery system based on real-time heartbeat analysis. Leveraging advanced heartbeat sensor technology, our approach aims to dynamically adjust anesthesia dosage in response to the patient’s physiological state. Through a series of controlled experiments and simulations, we assess the system’s ability to maintain optimal sedation levels while minimizing the risk of over-sedation or insufficient anaesthesia. Results demonstrate the potential for precise and individualized anaesthesia administration, enhancing patient safety and overall procedural outcomes. The study contributes valuable insights into the integration of physiological monitoring techniques for refining anaesthesia practices in medical settings.

articleTitle: BongFloralpedia: A comprehensive collection of diverse types of flowers growing in Ranaghat, West Bengal
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The automated identification of diverse floral species with high inter-class and intra-class similarities is crucial for monitoring the health of flowers in the floriculture industry which largely contributes to the revenue earned by agriculture industry of any country. In order to train the deep neural networks for this purpose, creation of novel databases comprising of multiple images belonging to diverse floral species is required to enable the networks to get acquainted with the varsities in their characteristics. Keeping the significance of databases in this research area into consideration, here we have designed a novel database namely, BongFloralpedia comprising of a total of 1920 flower images belonging to nine diverse types of species namely, Tuberose, Marigold, Ixora, Hibiscus, Crape Jasmine, Datura, Bougainvillea, Four o’ clock and Rose. The floral images included in this database are captured from real-fields located in Ranaghat, one of the most well-known flower cultivating regions of West Bengal which serves as the main inspiration behind naming the newly created database as “BongFloralpedia”. The images incorporated in this database possess complex backgrounds and are captured using different camera angles, under varied illumination conditions and thus depict the true characteristics of the considered species essential for reliable network training. The effectiveness of BongFloralpedia is validated by performing classification using several deep neural networks like AlexNet, Vgg16, ResNet152, MobileNetv2, ShuffleNetv2, SqueezeNet, InceptionV3, InceptionResNetv2, DenseNet121, NasNetLarge, NasNetMobile, GhostNetv2, EfficientNetB7 and Xception. Out of all these networks, DenseNet121 has given the best results by registering an overall Test Accuracy of 99.0 % and giving impressive outputs for quantitative parameters like Recall, Precision and F1 score.

articleTitle: A Study on Customized Face generator using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The Customized Face Generator (CFG) emerges as a ground-breaking response to a substantial challenge in the rapidly developing fields of computer graphics and artificial intelligence. Background issues for this study include the need to address ethical issues related to bias and representation in these digital identities as well as the growing desire for realistic and adaptable human faces across a range of industries, from entertainment to digital marketing. The design and development of a system that effortlessly blends diversity, realism, and personalization while preserving ethical standards is the main issue this research attempts to solve. It intends to provide users with the tools to create distinctive faces while upholding individual identities and avoiding damaging prejudices in generated content. The CFG’s ability to transform digital representation is its primary significance. It allows users to generate a variety of lifelike faces by utilizing cutting-edge deep learning techniques like GANs and VAEs, making for more engaging digital experiences and fostering greater individual expression. Modern technologies and ethical considerations are incorporated into the study approach. The architecture of the CFG is made to gradually add layers of complexity to faces as they are generated, giving them a more realistic appearance. In order to prevent offensive content, an easy-to-use customizing interface is created. The key result of from this research project includes a face creation system that is extremely adjustable and morally upright. The usefulness of the CFG is shown through quantitative metrics assessing diversity, realism, and user happiness together with qualitative evaluations. The CFG has enormous global relevance. It opens up a new level of inclusion and personalization in digital settings, having an impact on fields that depend on visual communication. This study adds to the ongoing conversation around moral AI and lays out a plan for responsible innovation, where technology meets both practical needs and social conscience.

articleTitle: Advancements in Schottky Diode Technology: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This comprehensive review explores the significant developments in Schottky diode technology, focusing on advancements, emerging trends, and key contributions in recent years. Schottky diodes, known for their fast switching speeds and low forward voltage drop, play a crucial role in various electronic applications, including rectifiers, mixers, and detectors. The review encompasses novel materials used and fabrication techniques. The discussion delves into the evolution of Schottky diodes, highlighting improvements in performance parameters such as efficiency, reliability, and thermal stability. The exploration of recent research endeavors covers topics such as nanoscale Schottky diodes, heterojunctions, and advancements in contact technologies, shedding light on their implications for enhanced device characteristics. Furthermore, the review addresses challenges faced in Schottky diode development and discusses potential solutions and future directions. The synthesis of research findings provides valuable insights for researchers, engineers, and practitioners interested in the continual evolution of Schottky diodes and their applications in modern electronic systems. This review serves as a comprehensive resource for understanding the state-of-the-art developments in Schottky diode technology and offers a roadmap for future research and innovation in this dynamic field.

articleTitle: Diabetes Detection System using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The increasing prevalence of diabetes in contemporary lifestyles underscores the need for swift and accurate diagnostic methods. Early detection is pivotal for effective management and prevention of complications, such as heart attacks, blindness, and kidney diseases, associated with diabetes mellitus. This research explores the application of machine learning in expediting the diagnosis of diabetes, offering a preliminary assessment that not only aids individuals but also supports governmental efforts in surveying diabetes prevalence in specific regions. Traditional diagnostic procedures often entail prolonged waiting periods and visits to diagnostic centers, impeding timely intervention. Leveraging machine learning and artificial intelligence, this study proposes an automated approach to analyze medical datasets, facilitating early detection and diagnosis of diabetes. The integration of advanced technologies promises to revolutionize diagnostic processes, offering a more efficient and timely response compared to conventional manual methods. This study demonstrates that the GridSearchCV-XGBClassifier performs better than other machine learning models, including K-Nearest Neighbours, Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting, Voting Classifier-XGB-SVM, and XGBoost, with an accuracy of 91.41%.

articleTitle: Mitigating Bias in Image Classification - Pretraining on Diverse Data for Improved Generalization
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Deep learning models have demonstrated remarkable abilities to learn complex patterns and concepts from the data they are trained on. However, recent studies have also revealed that these models can inherit and amplify the biases that exist in the data, such as those related to gender or race. These biases can pose serious ethical issues and need to be addressed. One possible solution to reduce these biases is to pretrain the models on large and diverse datasets that cover a broad spectrum of scenarios and features. In the current study,, we investigate the effect of pretraining and transfer learning on a biased dataset that we created using a subset of the celebA dataset. The dataset is biased towards people with black hair smiling and people with blonde hair not smiling. We use the new YOLO V8 model to classify the images based on whether the person in the image is smiling or not. The paper conducts a comparative analysis between a model that underwent no prior pretraining and a model pretrained on the ImageNet dataset. We find that the pretrained model has a lower bias and also a higher accuracy than the non-pretrained model. Our findings support that pretraining has the potential to reduce the bias in computer vision tasks while enhancing the model’s generalization capabilities.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence integration with the supply chain, making it green and sustainable
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: In the modern world, where ecological concerns and sustainability imperatives have become paramount, industries grapple with the challenge of aligning their practices with environmentally responsible objectives. The supply chain, a linchpin of global commerce, stands as a domain with immense potential for transformation. The paper is an attempt to find out how the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) with supply chain management can both increase efficiency and move supply chains in the direction of a greener, more sustainable future. An extensive examination of the state of AI integration in supply chains is done. It assesses how AI-driven technologies are adopted and used and how they affect supply chain efficiency, operational efficiency, and logistical difficulties. The study examines AI’s potential to reduce supply chain networks’ environmental impact in a number of areas. It explores the accuracy of demand forecasting, resource utilization optimization, and energy-efficient transportation routing. All this is expected to limit waste, energy use, and carbon emissions, in addition to lowering operational expenses. Additionally, it aims to provide a thorough understanding of AI’s contribution to supply chains’ ‘greening’ as well as their ‘sustainable’ transformation. The study makes the case that the incorporation of AI has the potential to catapult supply chains into a period of unmatched economic viability and environmental conscience and is expected to provide useful insights for a supply chain management industry that is more environmentally friendly and sustainable in the future.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Procedural and Predictive Systems on Drowsiness Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This study addresses the critical issue of drowsiness and driver fatigue, leading causes of fatal road accidents worldwide. The focus is on enhancing transportation safety by implementing an automatic driver drowsiness detection system using Python, incorporating OpenCV, Dlib, Tensorflow, and SciPy. The present study emphasizes the need for technological solutions to continuously monitor and measure driver attention, particularly during extended journeys. The proposed drowsiness detection system identifies closed eyes instances, alerting the driver to prevent potential accidents. A comparison between a deep learning LRCN model and a procedural EAR model shows that the EAR model achieves approximately three times faster execution time and higher accuracy in a GPU-exclusive environment. The procedural model achieves 83-86% accuracy on around 1000 images in 60-67 seconds, outperforming the LRCN model.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Mobile App Reviews Using Robotic Process Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is a rapidly growing technology that promises to automate mundane, repetitive, and time-consuming tasks, leading to improved productivity and efficiency. However, as with any new technology, RPA’s adoption and impact on the workforce depend on how users perceive it. This research aims to analyze the sentiment of RPA users to understand their attitudes, opinions, and experiences with the technology. To achieve this goal, we collected and analyzed a dataset of online reviews and social media posts related to RPA. We used natural language processing techniques to extract and classify sentiments, including positive, negative, and neutral. Our analysis revealed that RPA users have an overall positive sentiment towards the technology, with a majority of reviews expressing satisfaction with its capabilities and benefits.

articleTitle: Analysis of Lumen Maintenance of the High-Power pcLED bulbs produced in the Unorganized Sector under Tropical Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: This study investigates the performance of alpha and beta white pcLEDs in tropical conditions using the LM-80 lumen measuring method. The research aims to identify the differences between the two types of LEDs and their adaptability for specific uses. The study uses the TeSUL experimental setup to analyze lumen degradation trends in both types. The LM-80 lumen measuring method estimates the trajectory of lumen deterioration after 6000 hours, providing insights into future changes in lumen maintenance. The study also discusses the differences between alpha and beta LEDs, with alpha having a separate driver circuit, more cost, a one-year guarantee and low heat dissipation, while beta has a integrated driver circuit with shorter guarantee lasting only six months, less cost and high heat dissipation. The findings can help consumers make informed decisions on LED products, especially in countries with lower GDP levels. Future research could expand the experimental model to analyze lumen maintenance changes over a larger time span and explore different environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Design Evaluation and Uses of Paraphraser Content Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Paraphrasing is a challenging and important job in NLP, which involves generating alternative versions of text that preserve the original meaning. Paraphrasing can benefit many NLP applications, such as summarization, translation, and sentiment analysis, by improving the diversity, quality, and readability of the generated text. However, paraphrasing is not a trivial task, as it requires a deep understanding of the semantics and syntax of the text, as well as the ability to produce fluent and natural language. Existing paraphrasing tools are often limited in their scope, accuracy, and flexibility, and they cannot handle complex and diverse texts. In this project, we present Paraphraser, a novel and comprehensive software tool that can perform paraphrasing on any text, using advanced natural language processing techniques, deep learning models, and rich language resources. Paraphraser can generate multiple paraphrased versions of text, ranging from subtle rewording to significant revisions, while maintaining the real meaning and style. Paraphraser can also optimize the paraphrased text for various purposes, such as avoiding plagiarism, ensuring message clarity, and reaching a wider audience. Paraphraser is a versatile and reliable tool that can be used in various domains, such as content marketing, academic writing, and SEO optimization, enhancing the originality and attractiveness of textual content. We demonstrate the effectiveness and usefulness of Paraphraser through various experiments and evaluations, and we show how Paraphraser can improve the performance of various NLP tasks and applications.

articleTitle: FruityHub: A diverse collection of fruits created for edibility estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: The export of fresh fruits not only exerts a substantial influence on both national and global economies but also serves as a crucial source of livelihood for a vast number of farmers. Automated estimation of these fruits’ edibility (i.e. freshness level) is very essential to maintain the quality of exported fruits and to reduce the financial loss. Owing to the over-whelming performances achieved by deep neural networks in performing image classification tasks in recent years, many researchers have designed automated methods by exploiting the deep neural architectures to perform non-invasive quality identification of several plant parts (leaves, fruits, vegetables, etc.) in more time-efficient and cost-effective manner. The most notable hindrance which is faced by researchers while designing the automated methods is the lack of proper databases which are required to train them. To mitigate this research gap, in this work we have created a novel database namely, FruityHub comprising of a total of 1786 image frames belonging to eight different types of fruits namely, Dragon Fruits, Net Melons, Strawberries, Star Fruit, Zucchini, Mango, Pineapple and Plum. The image frames belonging to each fruit category can be classified as Fresh, Damaged and Severely Damaged which facilitates automated estimation of edible quality of these fruits depending upon their skin color, texture, shape, etc. We have also validated the effectiveness of this database using fourteen deep neural networks namely, AlexNet, Vgg16, ResNet152, MobileNetv2, ShuffleNetv2, SqueezeNet, InceptionV3, InceptionResNetv2, DenseNet121, NasNetLarge, NasNetMobile, GhostNetv2, EfficientNetB7 and Xception. The validation is performed using quantitative metrics like Test Accuracy, Recall, Precision and F1 score.

articleTitle: Decentralized Metadata Storage for Non-Fungible Token Collections Using Interplanetary File System
publicationTitle: 2023 7th International Conference on Electronics, Materials Engineering & Nano-Technology (IEMENTech)
abstract: Non-fungible tokens (NFTs) have become known as a game-changing digital asset class, revolutionizing digital content ownership and trade. These one-of-a-kind tokens symbolize a variety of digital and physical goods, including art, music, antiques, and more.
